purchased; any applicable refunds will be in pro-rated amount.

provided.

## More Than 40 Years of Innovation

# Geoenvironmental Experts

Transforming Complex Challenges Into Safe, High-Quality Solutions

###### Expert Solutions for Complex Challenges

## Geo-Solutions INC.

Geo-Solutions is a specialty geoenvironmental and geotechnical contractor focused on solving complex
subsurface challenges. We construct ground improvement, deep foundation support, earth retention,
and environmental containment systems using advanced techniques such as soil mixing, slurry
trenching, jet grouting, and grouting. We can also help with project design through
constructability  reviews, bench scale studies and pre-construction activities.

Our strength lies in applying a focused set of proven technologies to real-world conditions. Whether
working as a general contractor, specialty subcontractor, or design-build partner, we collaborate
with owners, engineers, and contractors to deliver practical, constructible solutions that perform
in the ground.

##### Expertise

Expertise represents what we know how to do at a professional and technical level. These categories
describe the core disciplines and problem domains—such as environmental remediation, groundwater
control, ground improvement, foundations, marine services, and preconstruction support—that guide
how projects are evaluated, designed, and executed.

[ Learn More ][92]

##### Solutions

Solutions focus on how the problem can be solved for our clients. Each solution describes a defined
outcome—such as cutoff walls, in situ treatment, bearing capacity improvement, slope stability, or
habitat restoration—rather than a single construction method.

[ Learn More ][93]
[Soil-Mixing In Situ]

##### Technologies

Technologies describe how we physically perform the work. These are the construction methods, tools,
and processes—such as soil mixing, jet grouting, slurry trenching, dredging, or auger cast
piles—that enable our solutions.

[ Learn More ][94]

###### Our Fundamental Foundation

## Health & Safety

Prioritizing the wellbeing of the people we work with and the people we serve.

###### Site Specific Safety Plans (SSSP or HASPs)

Safety plans start with our project superintendents, who will be onsite to oversee their
implementation.

###### Project Specific Task Hazard Analysis (THAs or JSAs or JHAs)

We carefully identify all potential hazards within every phase of the project and form a proactive
plan to mitigate risk.

###### Safety Audits / Inspections

We utilize electronic reporting to analyze all field occurrences in real time, enabling us to
constantly review safety observations.

###### Employee Training

All field staff members receive a minimum of 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER training with current eight-hour
updates and are enrolled in a medical monitoring program with yearly physicals.

###### Subcontractor Evaluation

We thoroughly vet any subcontractors we work with to ensure that their commitment to safety training
and procedures matches our own.

###### Stop Work Authority

Geo-Soluctions empowers every employee to stop work at any time if they feel they are working in an
unsafe environment without fear of repercussions.

## More Than 40 Years of Innovation

# Geoenvironmental Experts

Transforming Complex Challenges Into Safe, High-Quality Solutions

###### Expert Solutions for Complex Challenges

## Geo-Solutions INC.

Geo-Solutions is a specialty geoenvironmental and geotechnical contractor focused on solving complex
subsurface challenges. We construct ground improvement, deep foundation support, earth retention,
and environmental containment systems using advanced techniques such as soil mixing, slurry
trenching, jet grouting, and grouting. We can also help with project design through
constructability  reviews, bench scale studies and pre-construction activities.

Our strength lies in applying a focused set of proven technologies to real-world conditions. Whether
working as a general contractor, specialty subcontractor, or design-build partner, we collaborate
with owners, engineers, and contractors to deliver practical, constructible solutions that perform
in the ground.

##### Expertise

Expertise represents what we know how to do at a professional and technical level. These categories
describe the core disciplines and problem domains—such as environmental remediation, groundwater
control, ground improvement, foundations, marine services, and preconstruction support—that guide
how projects are evaluated, designed, and executed.

[ Learn More ][92]

##### Solutions

Solutions focus on how the problem can be solved for our clients. Each solution describes a defined
outcome—such as cutoff walls, in situ treatment, bearing capacity improvement, slope stability, or
habitat restoration—rather than a single construction method.

[ Learn More ][93]

and processes—such as soil mixing, jet grouting, slurry trenching, dredging, or auger cast
piles—that enable our solutions.

###### Our Fundamental Foundation

## Health & Safety

Prioritizing the wellbeing of the people we work with and the people we serve.

###### Site Specific Safety Plans (SSSP or HASPs)

Safety plans start with our project superintendents, who will be onsite to oversee their
implementation.

###### Project Specific Task Hazard Analysis (THAs or JSAs or JHAs)

We carefully identify all potential hazards within every phase of the project and form a proactive
plan to mitigate risk.

###### Safety Audits / Inspections

We utilize electronic reporting to analyze all field occurrences in real time, enabling us to
constantly review safety observations.

###### Employee Training

All field staff members receive a minimum of 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER training with current eight-hour
updates and are enrolled in a medical monitoring program with yearly physicals.

###### Subcontractor Evaluation

We thoroughly vet any subcontractors we work with to ensure that their commitment to safety training
and procedures matches our own.

###### Stop Work Authority

Geo-Soluctions empowers every employee to stop work at any time if they feel they are working in an
unsafe environment without fear of repercussions.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

## [Geotextile Tubes][85]

GSI manufactures GEOSTRUX™ Geotextile Tubes for use in a wide variety of projects where dewatering
of sediments and industrial wastes is required. These applications include coal ash ponds,
industrial sludge and sediments, mining tailings, wastewater treatment plant sludge, organic and
inorganic materials, and silts and sands. We also support environmental construction efforts such as
Superfund sites where the EPA manages environmental contamination cleanup projects, as well as
dredging contractors who require efficient dewatering.

[Learn More][86]
[[Geotextile Tubes]][87]

## A Leader in the Industry

GSI is one of the country’s largest independent installers of geotextile liners for landfill sites
and manages installation projects in all parts of the country. Additionally, with its GEOSTRUX™
Geotextile Tubes, GSI has supported sediment cleanup projects on waterways throughout the United
States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution
to landscape, environmental engineering and general contractors from its distribution facility in
Waukesha, Wisconsin.

GSI’s construction products focus on finding lasting environmental containment solutions for our
customers. Our slitting, seaming and re-rolling capabilities enable us to tailor products to fit
exact needs and specifications, while our large, centrally located facility allows guaranteed quick
shipments to any destination. In addition to our well-trained, Midwest-based customer service
professionals, we have product specialists located throughout the United States. Whatever your needs
or wherever your site is located, GSI is positioned to serve you.

[Learn More][80]
[[Construction Materials & Fabrics]][81]
[[Liner & Installation Services]][82]

## [Liner & Installation Services][83]

GSI is one of the largest installers of geotextile liners in the USA. Our installation services have
been utilized by a wide range of industries, including landfills, power and energy, civil
construction, EPA and Corp. of Engineers projects, pulp and paper, oil and gas, aquaculture,
agriculture and mining. GSI’s estimating, project management and construction operations are all
based in Waukesha, Wisconsin. Our installation crews operate from locations across the country,
enabling us to provide competitive local service from coast to coast.

[Learn More][84]

## [Geotextile Tubes][85]

GSI manufactures GEOSTRUX™ Geotextile Tubes for use in a wide variety of projects where dewatering
of sediments and industrial wastes is required. These applications include coal ash ponds,
industrial sludge and sediments, mining tailings, wastewater treatment plant sludge, organic and
inorganic materials, and silts and sands. We also support environmental construction efforts such as
Superfund sites where the EPA manages environmental contamination cleanup projects, as well as
dredging contractors who require efficient dewatering.

[Learn More][86]
[[Geotextile Tubes]][87]

## A Leader in the Industry

GSI is one of the country’s largest independent installers of geotextile liners for landfill sites
and manages installation projects in all parts of the country. Additionally, with its GEOSTRUX™
Geotextile Tubes, GSI has supported sediment cleanup projects on waterways throughout the United
States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution
to landscape, environmental engineering and general contractors from its distribution facility in
Waukesha, Wisconsin.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,

continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

## Infrastructure for a Sustainable Future

### [View Products][76] | [Review Projects][77] | [Contact Us][78]
* ### CCR APPLICATIONS
  
  ## Beating the New Challenges of CCR
  
  The EPA’s ruling on the disposal of coal combustion residuals has defined the standard for
  successful containment and closure of coal combustion residuals (CCR) facilities. Since then, AGRU
  America has been committed to becoming the supplier of choice for CCR-related applications.
  
  Discover industry-leading geosynthetics specially designed for the closure and containment of CCR.
  Manufactured to meet even the most stringent project parameters, AGRU’s products provide
  state-of-the-art solutions for CCR impoundments and landfills.
  
  [LEARN MORE][79]
* ### ENERGY, OIL & GAS
  
  ## Unparalleled Benefits for Energy & Oil
  
  Manufactured using the flat die calendered extrusion process, AGRU America’s HDPE and LLDPE
  geomembranes deliver numerous benefits including containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  cost savings. All AGRU geomembranes, geocomposites, geotextiles, geonets, geosynthetic clay
  liners, and other geosynthetic materials are manufactured in the U.S. and meet stringent quality
  control standards.
  
  These geomembranes and geosynthetic products offer unparalleled benefits for energy, oil, and gas
  applications.
  
  [LEARN MORE][80]
* ### ENVIRONMENTAL
  
  ## The Highest Degree of Containment
  
  When it comes to the environment, it pays to use the best waste management solutions available. As
  the industry-leading producer of geosynthetics in North America, AGRU America and its flat die
  calendered extrusion process delivers the highest and most consistent quality geomembrane and
  geosynthetic products for environmental applications. Our products are the perfect solution for
  applications requiring the highest degree of containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  erosion prevention.
  
  [LEARN MORE][81]
* [][82]

## Infrastructure for a Sustainable Future

### [View Products][76] | [Review Projects][77] | [Contact Us][78]
* ### CCR APPLICATIONS
  
  ## Beating the New Challenges of CCR
  
  The EPA’s ruling on the disposal of coal combustion residuals has defined the standard for
  successful containment and closure of coal combustion residuals (CCR) facilities. Since then, AGRU
  America has been committed to becoming the supplier of choice for CCR-related applications.
  
  Discover industry-leading geosynthetics specially designed for the closure and containment of CCR.
  Manufactured to meet even the most stringent project parameters, AGRU’s products provide
  state-of-the-art solutions for CCR impoundments and landfills.
  
  [LEARN MORE][79]
* ### ENERGY, OIL & GAS
  
  ## Unparalleled Benefits for Energy & Oil
  
  Manufactured using the flat die calendered extrusion process, AGRU America’s HDPE and LLDPE
  geomembranes deliver numerous benefits including containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  cost savings. All AGRU geomembranes, geocomposites, geotextiles, geonets, geosynthetic clay
  liners, and other geosynthetic materials are manufactured in the U.S. and meet stringent quality
  control standards.
  
  These geomembranes and geosynthetic products offer unparalleled benefits for energy, oil, and gas
  applications.
  
  [LEARN MORE][80]
* ### ENVIRONMENTAL
  
  ## The Highest Degree of Containment
  
  When it comes to the environment, it pays to use the best waste management solutions available. As
  the industry-leading producer of geosynthetics in North America, AGRU America and its flat die
  calendered extrusion process delivers the highest and most consistent quality geomembrane and
  geosynthetic products for environmental applications. Our products are the perfect solution for
  applications requiring the highest degree of containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  erosion prevention.
  
  [LEARN MORE][81]

## Best-in-Class Service

We are your Plastics Experts. AGRU is an international manufacturer of innovative engineering
plastics that is always prepared to meet challenges with robust solutions. AGRU develops the highest
quality products for applications ranging from waste management and water conservation to mining and
energy.

Our award-winning research has led to the development of our flat-die calendered extrusion process,
which can produce geomembranes with unique surface structures such as spikes or drain studs. And our
constant focus on research and development has led to numerous breakthroughs in lining systems, HDPE
piping systems, concrete protection, and more.

Since 1988, we have been committed to offering our customers the highest quality products and
long-term solutions. That commitment is only made possible by our competent staff and their
willingness to challenge accepted norms. With worldwide locations, an AGRU representative is always
on standby to help.

  personal touch that makes AGRU far and away the best overall value.”

  increase in installation rates when interfaced with GCL, Geotextile, and Geocomposite materials.
  Slip-sheeting is not required due to the absence of the ‘Velcro®’ Effect… We can count on AGRU to
  provide materials that help us in a very competitive market.”
  
  ### Michael Salley

* “In the short time we’ve been dealing with AGRU, they’ve proven to be one of our very best
  vendors. Their product is of the finest quality, and their service is even better. When we place
  an order, we have a response within minutes – with the order going out in a day or two. When we
  ask a question, we again have a response quicker than most of our manufacturers.”
  
  ### Craig Florence

* “In addition to the quality products we order from AGRU, the customer service I receive always

## ABOUT US

## Welcome to A&T Geosynthetics!

A&T Geosynthetics, we are dedicated to provide high-quality geosynthetic products that meet the
diverse needs of our clients in the infrastructure and environmental sectors. As a leading
manufacturer and exporter based in India, we specialize in a range of innovative solutions designed
to enhance the performance and longevity of infrastructure projects

## A&T Geosynthetics

We’re passionate about strengthening your projects with our top-notch geosynthetic products. As a
leading manufacturer, we provide a diverse range of geosynthetic products, including Geostrip
(ATSTRIP), Nonwoven Geotextile (ATGTX), Drainage Geocomposite (ATDRAIN), Geocell (ATWEB), and
Geogrid (ATGRID).

## A&T Geosynthetics

Our commitment to quality means that every product is designed to meet the highest engineering
standards. Together, let's build a future that stands strong.

[ Previous ][13] [ Next ][14]

## OUR Products

##### HDPE Geocell
##### ATWEB

Brings unmatched strength and versatility, the unique system features heavy duty polymeric strips
that are ultrasonically welded into a robust honeycomb structure, providing exceptional confinement.

[Read More][15]

##### Drainage Geocomposite –
##### ATDRAIN

The innovative Geocomposite drain, crafted by expertly layering a robust geonet drainage core
between two protective geotextile layers, it stands out with its optional geomembrane enhancement.

[Read More][16]

##### Geogrid Biaxial –
##### ATGRID PP

Are integrally formed biaxial geogrids manufactured from superior grades of UV stabilized
polypropylene using precisely controlled extrusion, punching, and drawing processes.

[Read More][17]

##### Nonwoven Geotextile –
##### ATGTX

ATGTX is nonwoven polypropylene geotextile made with PP staple yarns which are thermally bonded
through needle punching to form a strong, flexible and dimensionally stable fabric structure with
optimum pore sizes and high permeability.

[Read More][18]

##### Geostrip –
##### ATSTRIP

ATSTRIPS are geosynthetic strips comprise tendons of polyester yarns encased in a polyethylene
sheath. Specifically engineered for the reinforcement of soils and other fills for the construction
of reinforced soil walls.

[Read More][19]

projects.

Skilled professionals ensuring high-quality geosynthetic product manufacturing and service.

Environmentally conscious manufacturing processes
focused on long-term sustainability.

##### Cost Effective Solutions

Affordable, value-driven products tailored to meet project requirements efficiently.

##### Production Capacity

With a production capacity of 350 tonnes per month, we ensure timely delivery.

##### Timely Delivery

Reliable and punctual delivery for seamless project progress and client satisfaction

# Arkayana Lestari Grup

Leading Geotextile Distributor in Indonesia

[ About Us ][14]

## About Us

Arkayana Lestari Grup, formerly Agro Yasa Lestari, supplies high-quality woven and non-woven
geotextiles, geomembranes and geosynthetic materials — a leading geotextile distributor in
Indonesia.

Backed by a robust warehousing and logistics network, we deliver timely, reliable material
distribution and project supply to construction sites across the country. Guided by a commitment to
quality, integrity and professional service, we have built lasting partnerships with contractors,
engineering consultants and government projects, serving infrastructure, road, water-management and
environmental works.

[Geotextile product range]
[Construction-site application]
[Warehousing and logistics centre]

Our Journey

## Milestones

2021

Founded as Agro Yasa Lestari (AYLS), entering Indonesia's geosynthetics market.

2022

Built our first network of suppliers and contractors, with steady growth in geotextile sales.

2023

Expanded warehousing and logistics capacity, extending project supply to more provinces.

2024

Broadened the product portfolio with geomembranes and further geotechnical solutions.

2026

Officially renamed Arkayana Lestari Grup, opening a new chapter of brand renewal and expansion.

## Write an investor-ready business plan from scratch

Most founder business plans never see an investor because they were written for the wrong audience
using the wrong template. The Business Plan Playbook Ebook is the founder-friendly guide to writing
a serious plan that actually gets read - covering structure, financial section depth, market sizing
and the narrative arc investors and lenders look for.

By the end you will have a business plan structure that works for both fundraising and operating,
plus the templates to fill it in.

## What's Inside the Business Plan Playbook Ebook

Every section is written to be read on a phone or a desktop, with the goal of getting you to action
faster.
* Comprehensive Checklist A detailed, actionable checklist that ensures you’ve covered every
  critical component of your business plan, from market research to financial forecasting and
  everything in between.
* Prompt Pack Get inspired with prompts that help you articulate your business goals, mission,
  vision, and strategies clearly and persuasively. Perfect for crafting investor-ready plans or
  improving internal alignment.
* Interactive Workbook A practical, hands-on workbook filled with exercises, frameworks, and
  templates to guide you through writing each section of your business plan.
* E-Book Dive deep into business planning with this expert-written e-book. It covers best practices,
  common mistakes to avoid, and actionable tips to create a plan that stands out.
* Step-by-Step Guide A user-friendly guide that simplifies the complex process of business planning.
  Follow this roadmap to ensure no detail is overlooked.
* Business Plan Template (Customizable for Any Business) Save time with a professionally designed
  business plan template that’s fully customizable. This template is available as an editable
  Word-Document for your convenience.
* Financial Plan Template Create a solid financial foundation for your business with a detailed
  financial plan template. Includes revenue projections, expense tracking, cash flow analysis, and
  break-even calculations, all tailored for startups and small businesses. This template is
  available in multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) to suit your needs.
* Aspiring entrepreneurs looking to bring their ideas to life.

## Who This Ebook Is For
* Pre-seed and seed founders preparing fundraising materials
* Small business owners applying for bank loans or grants
* Side-hustlers formalising a real business plan for the first time
* Consultants writing business plans for their clients

## Format & Instant Delivery
* **Format:** Ebook (PDF)
* **Language:** English
* **Delivery:** Instant download by email after purchase
* **Works on:** iPad, Kindle, mobile, desktop - any device that opens PDFs

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long should a business plan be?

20-40 pages is typical for investor plans, 15-25 for lender plans. The ebook covers the differences
in depth required for each audience.

### Do I need a full business plan or just a pitch deck?

Both serve different audiences. The ebook covers when a pitch deck is sufficient (most early-stage
VC conversations) and when a full plan is required (bank loans, grants, accelerators).

### How do I write the financial projections section?

The ebook walks through bottom-up financial modelling, key assumptions and the projection format
lenders and investors expect.

### Is there an AI tool for business plans?

Yes - Avvale's AI Business Plan Generator. The ebook covers how to use AI to draft a plan and the
editing layer required to make it investor-grade.

### How is this different from the bespoke business plan service?

This ebook teaches you to write your own plan. The bespoke service is a fully written plan by Avvale
consultants - we typically build these for live fundraising rounds where investor-grade depth is
required.

## Built by Avvale Consulting

Avvale Consulting has helped 300+ founders across 30+ countries raise capital and grow their
businesses since 2015. This ebook is the productised version of the knowledge we share with paying
clients - so you can apply it without the consulting bill.

Launching your first physical product is the most exciting and most over-romanticised path in

matters: validation, sourcing, packaging, fulfilment and selling the first 1,000 units profitably.

By the end you will have a physical product validated by real demand, a supplier relationship and a
launch plan that does not assume infinite capital.

## What's Inside the Launch Your First Physical Product Ebook

Every section is written to be read on a phone or a desktop, with the goal of getting you to action
faster.
* Getting Started with Minimal Investment: Discover practical steps to start your product journey
  without needing huge upfront costs.
* Developing & Protecting Your Product Idea: Learn how to refine your product concept and protect it

## OUR PRODUCTS

Geotextiles are large sheets that can save our Earth’s soil on rainy days and can also bind it
strongly. *It is also known as *[non woven needle punched fabric][70]***. ***It is mostly used for
filtration and separation in the road constructions along with protecting from migration of small
gravels and sand aggregates. They are a permeable synthetic material made of textile materials which
usually are made from polymers like polyester and polypropylene. We manufacture both.

B. J. GEO-TEXTILE LIMITED is a Best Geotextile Manufacturer premium class [Geotextile Fabrics][71],
that are thin and strong membrane fabric that can be used to reinforce soil and prevent from any
damage. Our fabrics can safely be used in road construction, especially to fill gaps between the
roads to improve the soil structure along with making the poor soil more beneficial for use and then
easy to build in difficult places also. Grow Bags are an affordable alternative to plastic
containers for gardening.

Jute geotextile is another product we manufacture. Different types of jute-geotextiles have already
been created by combining jute with other natural fibers in specific proportions and fabricating
them in a specific pattern. Jute seed pad aids the rapid growth of vegetation and cultivation and
protects seed from extreme weather as well.

[

## Geotextile Bag

Geotextile bags are made from nonwoven geotextile. Used in civil engineering projects including
roadworks, drainage systems.
][72]
[

## Synthetic Geotextile Sheet

They are made from high strength polypropylene fiber and European additives. Used in separation and
filtration projects.
][73]
[

## Geotube

Geotube or Geotextile tube is an engineered textile tube for dewatering sludge, tailings, or
dredging spoils.
][74]
[

## Prefabricated Vertical Drains (PVD)

Vertical Drains also called wick drains are installed to improve the consolidation time of soft
soil.
][75]
[

## Woven Geo-Textile

Woven geotextile is used for filtration & drainage media in roads & retaining walls, slope
protection, ground stabilization, landscaping.
][76]
[

## Jute Seed Pad

Jute Seed Pad Usually used to protect soil and help the growth of vegetation. It is environment
friendly and biodegradable jute pad.
][77]

Geo liner, also known as geosynthetic liner, is a low-permeable synthetic membrane used in
geotechnical engineering. As the leading geomembrane and geotextile manufacturer, supplier and

digester applications. Typically, geomembranes are available in various colors, such as black,

prevent soil erosion, contributing to the longevity of infrastructure.

Engineered continuous-filament and staple-fiber geotextiles designed for subgrade stabilization,
subsurface drainage, structural filtration, and hydraulic erosion control.

## Engineering Application & Specification Selection Guide

Cross-indexed technical configurations designed to align structural soil mechanics with dynamic
hydraulic filtration criteria.

200 – 400 GSM

### Subgrade Stabilization

**Mechanics:** High-tensile separation & load distribution. Prevents intermixing of cohesive soft
subgrade soils with structural aggregate base courses in roads and rail networks.

100 – 200 GSM

### Subsurface Drainage

**Mechanics:** Dynamic planar flow & high water transmissivity. Facilitates lateral drainage
migration while retaining adjacent structural subsoil profiles.

80 – 150 GSM

### Filtration Systems

**Mechanics:** Calibrated Apparent Opening Size (AOS). Engineered for wrapping trench
configurations, retaining fine particles while ensuring non-clogging performance.

150 – 250 GSM

### Erosion Control

**Mechanics:** Hydraulic shear defense & root interlocking. Safely shields coastal revetments,
riverbanks, and geometric slope gradients from heavy hydraulic scour forces.

● Production Scale & Infrastructure

## High-Capacity Geotextile Manufacturing Plant

Operating multi-line automated needle-punching complexes in Jiangsu Province. Engineered to
eliminate technical gauge variance and secure massive tier-1 commercial scale volumes.

5,000+ Tons

### Annual Fabric Output

Continuous baseline extrusion capacity guarantees uninterrupted cross-quarter dispatch for mega
infrastructure pipelines.

6.0 Meters

### Maximum Seamless Width

Extra-wide roll adaptation substantially mitigates structural overlap margins and saves on-site
contractor placement labor.

80-1200 GSM

### Custom Weight Spectrum

Calibrated micro-adjustments for multi-layer composite matrixing, accommodating niche civil
engineering sub-grade blueprints.

#### Automated Blending

Computer-controlled pneumatic fiber opening and multi-stage blending ensure flawless isotropic fiber
distribution before carding.

#### High-Density Punching

Advanced variable-stroke needle matrices produce superior fiber interlocking, maximizing vertical
permeability and puncture thresholds.

#### Thermal Calibration

Integrated online heat-setting calendars fix fabric thickness metrics, preventing elastic creep and
dynamic roll deformation.

#### Logistics Proximity

Strategically localized within the Yangtze River Delta industrial hub. Fast tracking routes directly
to Shanghai Port terminal gates.

★ MECHANICAL PERFORMANCE DATA

five-year fix.

Plastic was never designed
to return to the ground

## Polypropylene.
## Polyester.
## Polyethylene.

Engineered from petroleum.
Built for performance.
Designed for permanence.

The materials that dominate modern geotextiles are engineered from petroleum. They are built to
resist decay. They are built to outlast weather, water, soil, and time.

They were never meant to return to the earth.

So they do not.

Built to last.
Longer than we should.
**450 – 500** Years

Estimated persistence in soil
for synthetic geotextiles.

Every piece ever made,
still exists somewhere.

Plastic doesn’t disappear.
It fragments.
It leaches.
It remains.

### Synthetic

Petroleum based
Non-biodegradable
Long-term contamination

**VS.**

### Natural Fiber

Plant based
Biodegradable
Returns to the earth

The ground remembers everything we leave behind. →

8.3B

Land Burden
23×
More

The oceans get the headlines. The land is the real crisis.

500
/ m²

Synthetic geotextiles can shed particles into the ground they were installed to protect.

Breakdown Time

Years

The project ends. The plastic does not.

everything we leave behind.

Colonial Construction Materials supplies site work products that control erosion, stabilize soil and

## Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between geotextiles and geomembranes?

Geotextiles are permeable fabrics designed for filtration, separation, and soil reinforcement,
allowing water to pass through. In contrast, geomembranes are impermeable liners designed to be a
barrier, completely blocking the passage of liquids, which is essential for containment in projects
like landfills or ponds.

When should I use ground protection mats?

Ground protection mats are the ideal solution when you need to move heavy vehicles or equipment over
sensitive surfaces like turf, soil, or decorated pavement without causing damage. They create a
temporary, stable roadway that prevents rutting and protects the ground underneath, making them
perfect for construction sites, outdoor events, and utility work.

How do I choose the right product for my project's specific needs?

The best way is to contact our technical team. By understanding your project requirements—such as
soil type, load-bearing needs, chemical exposure, and project goals—we can recommend the most
suitable and cost-effective geosynthetic or protection mat solution from our product range.

What information do you need to provide an accurate quote?

To give you a precise quote, we typically need to know the product you’re interested in, the
required quantity (usually in square meters or number of mats), the material specifications or
performance requirements, and the destination port for shipping. Any project drawings or technical
details you can share are also very helpful.

Do you ship internationally and provide necessary documentation?

Yes, we have extensive experience shipping our products to clients all over the world. We handle all
aspects of international logistics and provide a full set of documentation, including technical data
sheets, quality certificates, and customs paperwork, to ensure a smooth delivery process to your
site or port.

#### Our Product Categories

We offer a complete suite of engineered geosynthetics materials:

#### Geotextile

A permeable fabric used to separate, filter, reinforce, protect, or drain soil in civil engineering
and environmental applications.
[Learn More][97]

#### Geomembrane

An impermeable synthetic liner used for containment and seepage control in landfills, ponds, and
wastewater treatment projects.
[Learn More][98]

#### Geogrid

Geogrids are high-strength geosynthetic materials made from polymers such as polypropylene (PP) or
high-density polyethylene (HDPE), designed specifically for soil reinforcement and stabilization. 
[Learn More][99]

#### Ground Protection Mat

A durable panel designed to distribute loads and stabilize the ground for roads, construction sites,
and temporary accessways.
[Learn More][100]

#### Engineering Plastics

High-performance plastic materials engineered for strength, heat resistance, and durability in
industrial and structural applications.
[Learn More][101]

Geosynthetics are a broad category of synthetic products used in geotechnical and civil engineering
applications. They include materials such as **geomembranes, geotextiles, geogrids, geonets,
geocells,** and **geosynthetic clay liners (GCLs)**. These products offer multiple advantages that
enhance the performance, sustainability, and cost-efficiency of modern infrastructure projects.

[Why Choose Us][84]

[EcoGeoX Limited][85]

[EcoGeoX: Eco is the short term of Ecological, Geo is the prefix of Geosynthetics, X stands for the
different materials such as Geomembrane, Geotextile, Geogrid, Geocell, Geonet, Geocomposite, so on
and etc. EcoGeoX Geosynthetics manufactures & distributes & markets a wide range of Geosynthetics
products, including the Geomembrane, Geotextile, Geosynthetics Clay Liner (GCL), Geogrid, Geocell,
Geonet, Geocomposites, Geobag and Fiber etc. geosynthetics materials to international markets. We
have become a leader supplier for all requirements in the geosynthetics field, capable of offer our
customers a wide range of solutions. The experience acquired over the years, made our products range
complete, either for its wideness, reaching a high quality level and competitiveness. The steady
attention during production processing and a strict selection of the raw materials is our guarantee
of a full compliance with the market reference standards.][86]

[View More][87]

[Company News][88]
* [ [EcoGeoX Geomembrane for Mining & Industrial & Landfill & Pond Use] ][89]
  
  [EcoGeoX Geomembrane for Mining & Industrial & Landfill & Pond Use][90]
  
  [EcoGeoX Geomembrane acts as a critical impermeable barrier in primary and secondary landfill
  lining systems. It effectively seals hazardous waste, prevents toxic leachate from contaminating
  surrounding soil and groundwater, and provides reliable cap closure solutions for long-term
  municipal waste isolation.][91]
  
  Jul. 24, 2026
* [ [EcoGeoX Geomembrane | Offer Complete Containment Liner Solutions] ][92]
  
  [EcoGeoX Geomembrane | Offer Complete Containment Liner Solutions][93]
  
  [EcoGeoX Geomembrane is widely used in water containment, landfill lining, mining tailings
  storage, aquaculture ponds, wastewater treatment, reservoirs, canals, irrigation systems, oil &
  gas containment, biogas plants and environmental protection projects. It provides excellent
  impermeability, chemical resistance, UV stability and long-term durability for global engineering
  applications.][94]
  
  Jul. 23, 2026

[Our Partner][95]

[Application][96]

* [Advanced EcoGeoX Concrete Liners with Top Integrated Anchor Studs][98]
* [Industrial Concrete Protective Liners (CPL) --- EcoGeoX Solutions][99]

[FAQ][100]

  Both. Our manufacturer/factory is located in Shando

* Are you a factory or trading company? Where is your company located?
  
  Both. Our manufacturer/factory is located in Shandong, China. Also we have two trading companies
  in Hong Kong and Qingdao respectively, in order to offer more professional service to our clients
  friends.
* What kind of testing do you have for products?
  
  We have ISO, CMA, CE.
* How do you ensure the quality?
  
  We are working with three QC processes to guarantee the quality: 1. For raw materials; 2. Onsite
  inspection during production; 3. Final QC test for each batch of finished products. Meantime, we
  have our own laboratory with the whole and complete procedures for quality guarantee.
* What is your productivity?
  
  Normally about 2 to 3 days as the production period for one 20GP or 40HQ of Geomembrane and
  Geotextile, GCL etc. Others within one week.

## ***ESI Footing Direct offers education, resources and products to bring a competition level arena
## anywhere.***

Your arena is a dynamic system, and a vital part of your training regimen. A good riding surface is
important to your horse’s health and comfort. ESI Footing Direct offers affordable options to
provide your site with ESI’s world class blended footing, as well as additives and maintenance
equipment for your riding surfaces.

#### **Not all footing is created equal**

Our top-quality product line will provide your arena with the potential for peak performance both
conveniently and cost effectively. We believe that each customer deserves the best footing, and we
are confident that you will find our products second to none.

ESI Footing Direct is devoted to providing customers the best arena additives, products and riding
surfaces at a reasonable price. We have taken the knowledge and expertise offered by ESI Footing of
creating and building world renowned riding surfaces and have developed a program to make the
acquisition of these products more readily available to clients no matter their geographic location.
Customer service is one of main priorities, and after receiving countless inquiries about our
products and services all over the United States, ESI was committed to developing a service that
would make our world-renowned footing, products, education & expertise more readily available
door-to-door. All in all, our heart is our core team, who’s in depth knowledge of materials,
production techniques, and safety will provide you with the resources to make the best decisions
possible for you and your horse.
* SUPERIOR PRODUCTS
* DOOR-TO-DOOR SERVICE
* PERSONALIZED ACCESSIBILITY OF MATERIALS & SERVICES
* CLIENT EDUCATION
* LONG-TERM RELATIONSHIPS
* PROFESSIONALISM

With over 25 years in the industry, ESI is committed to offering excellence in all of our products
and services, which has allowed us to continue to foster and grow long term client relationships.
With our Footing Direct program, ESI can now provide more flexibility and customization than ever
before to meet your riding surface needs. We have tailored this new program to help create a more
cost-effective option for our clientele all over the US. This program not only allows clients better
access to our products & services no matter the location, but also continues to provide the
education & customer service that ESI is known for.

We look forward to working with you to help bring your equestrian dreams to life!

## Footer

### Testimonials

The arena that ESI just built for us in NY used to be a traditional sand/stone mix. The ESI team
came in and totally re-graded and rebuilt the arena, putting all new footing in. Now we are really
enjoying the arena, I think it is fabulous and I’m pretty sure it is going to last with very low
maintenance for a really long period of time.

McLain Ward, 2 Time Olympic Champion

As a course designer safety for horses and riders is always first, this arena is not slippery and we
can really build exciting turns. This is amazing here; this footing is perfect. I have seen rings
around the world all my life and this may be number 1.

Olaf Petersen, World-renowned course designer

What I’m seeing done here at Wellington’s WEF [by ESI] is fairly amazing. I’ve always believed that
the Wellington facility should be to the United States what Aachen is to Germany and Spruce Meadows
is to Canada–the calling card of our sport

Ian Millar, Eight-time Olympian

  information with your friends and family. If you have a question about our company or something
  you’ve seen in the news, give us a call at (772) 221-0707.

## ***ESI Footing Direct offers education, resources and products to bring a competition level arena
## anywhere.***

Your arena is a dynamic system, and a vital part of your training regimen. A good riding surface is
important to your horse’s health and comfort. ESI Footing Direct offers affordable options to
provide your site with ESI’s world class blended footing, as well as additives and maintenance
equipment for your riding surfaces.

#### **Not all footing is created equal**

Our top-quality product line will provide your arena with the potential for peak performance both
conveniently and cost effectively. We believe that each customer deserves the best footing, and we
are confident that you will find our products second to none.

ESI Footing Direct is devoted to providing customers the best arena additives, products and riding
surfaces at a reasonable price. We have taken the knowledge and expertise offered by ESI Footing of
creating and building world renowned riding surfaces and have developed a program to make the
acquisition of these products more readily available to clients no matter their geographic location.
Customer service is one of main priorities, and after receiving countless inquiries about our
products and services all over the United States, ESI was committed to developing a service that
would make our world-renowned footing, products, education & expertise more readily available
door-to-door. All in all, our heart is our core team, who’s in depth knowledge of materials,
production techniques, and safety will provide you with the resources to make the best decisions
possible for you and your horse.
* SUPERIOR PRODUCTS
* DOOR-TO-DOOR SERVICE
* PERSONALIZED ACCESSIBILITY OF MATERIALS & SERVICES
* CLIENT EDUCATION
* LONG-TERM RELATIONSHIPS
* PROFESSIONALISM

With over 25 years in the industry, ESI is committed to offering excellence in all of our products
and services, which has allowed us to continue to foster and grow long term client relationships.
With our Footing Direct program, ESI can now provide more flexibility and customization than ever
before to meet your riding surface needs. We have tailored this new program to help create a more
cost-effective option for our clientele all over the US. This program not only allows clients better
access to our products & services no matter the location, but also continues to provide the
education & customer service that ESI is known for.

We look forward to working with you to help bring your equestrian dreams to life!

## Our Mission

The mission of Exeed Geotextile is to be a leading provider of innovative and sustainable geotextile
solutions, empowering construction and civil engineering projects worldwide. We are dedicated to
delivering high-performance geotextile materials that reinforce, protect, and enhance the integrity
of infrastructure and environmental systems. Through cutting-edge research, advanced manufacturing
techniques, and a commitment to customer satisfaction, we aim to be the go-to partner for engineers,
contractors, and project developers seeking reliable and cost-effective geotextile solutions. 

[read more][50]

## Our Vision

Our vision at Exeed Geotextile is to be the driving force behind the advancement of geotextile
technology, setting new industry standards for quality, efficiency, and environmental
responsibility. We envision a future where our geotextile solutions play a pivotal role in building
resilient and sustainable infrastructure, safeguarding the environment, and mitigating the impact of
construction on ecosystems. By continuously exploring innovative applications, promoting sustainable
practices, and fostering collaborations, we aspire to create a positive and lasting impact on the
construction industry and the world at large.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

our diverse solutions:** from reinforced structures to geosynthetics and geohazards protective

## **Our international network of experts**

[[Geoquest around the world]][128]

Through our network of nearly 40 subsidiaries and local agents globally,
we provide you access to the expertise of an international group wherever you are.

[Contact us][129]
[[Geoquest]][130]

Geoquest has forged an unrivalled level of expertise and experience in reinforced backfill
applications and soil-structure interaction. Our technical solutions are defined by four functions
corresponding to the purpose of the structure to be designed: RETAIN, CROSS, PROTECT, STRENGTHEN.

Over the last 60 years, Geoquest has been setting the gold standard in reinforced earth structures
and has played an active role in over 100,000 projects around the world.

**What Are Geotextiles and Geo Fabrics?**

Geotextiles are permeable fabrics used in geotechnical engineering applications. They play a vital
role in soil stabilization, erosion control, and drainage systems. In simple terms, geo fabrics are
materials that help to separate, filter, reinforce, protect, or drain soil in construction projects.

Geotextile materials are made from synthetic fibers such as polypropylene or polyester, which are
woven or nonwoven to create products with varying degrees of strength and flexibility. These fabrics
help manage the natural environment by preventing soil erosion, improving drainage, and stabilizing
roads, railways, and embankments.

**Types of Geotextile Fabrics We Manufacture**

As a leading Geo Textile Manufacturer in India, we offer an extensive range of geotextile fabrics
tailored for various applications. Here are the main types of geotextile fabrics we manufacture:

**Woven Geo Textiles**: Made from woven synthetic fibers, these geotextiles are primarily used for
soil reinforcement and separation in road construction, embankments, and erosion control.

**Non-Woven Geo Textiles**: These are made from synthetic fibers that are bonded together without
weaving. Non-woven geotextiles are widely used for filtration, drainage, and separation
applications.

**Geo Grids**: These geosynthetics are used for reinforcement, particularly in the construction of
roads, embankments, and slopes.

**Geo Cells**: Cellular structures used for controlling soil erosion and stabilizing the ground.

**Geo Membranes****:** Used for waterproofing applications, geo membranes provide a barrier to
liquid and gases, essential in landfills and ponds.

Each of these products is designed for durability and efficiency, ensuring that they contribute
effectively to the success of your civil engineering projects.

**Applications of Geotextile Products**

Geotextiles are versatile materials used in a variety of civil, environmental, and construction
applications. Below are some of the primary ways our geotextile products are used:

**Erosion Control**: **Geotextile fabrics** help to stabilize the soil, preventing erosion due to
wind or water. They are commonly used for coastal protection, slope stabilization, and riverbank
reinforcement.

**Road Construction**: **Geotextiles** improve the stability and durability of roads, railways, and
highways. Our road construction geotextiles are designed to withstand heavy traffic loads while
maintaining soil integrity.

**Drainage Systems**: **Geotextiles** are widely used for filtering water and preventing clogging in
drainage systems. Filtration geotextile rolls are highly effective in keeping the drainage system
efficient and clog-free.

**Landfill Liner Systems**: Geotextiles are used in landfill operations to separate and filter
leachate, ensuring that hazardous materials are contained.

**Coastal Protection**: Used for creating barriers against coastal erosion, geotextiles protect
beaches and shorelines from the damaging effects of waves and storms.

**Slope Stabilization**: Geotextiles help prevent soil slides and enhance the stability of slopes,
ensuring the safety of infrastructure built on sloped terrains.

**Our Product Range**

As a Geo Textile Company, we provide a broad range of geotextile solutions that cater to various
civil and environmental applications. Here’s an overview of the products we manufacture:

**Geo Tube**: [Geo Tubes][40] have large, tubular structures are often used for dewatering purposes
in civil engineering projects, providing an effective solution for managing water during
construction and landscaping.

**Woven Geo Textile**: [Woven Geotextile][41] is a strong, durable fabric used for soil
reinforcement, road construction, and erosion control. Our woven geotextile supplier network ensures
that you get high-quality, dependable products for your projects.

**Non-Woven Geo Textile**: [Non-Woven Geotextiles][42] are excellent for filtration and drainage
applications, making them ideal for use in construction sites, water management, and drainage
systems.

**Woven Geo Bag**: [Woven Geo Bag][43] are used for controlling sediment, erosion, and water
filtration in hydraulic and environmental projects, providing easy handling and excellent
durability.

**Non-Woven Geo Bags**: Similar to woven bags but made with nonwoven geotextile materials,
Non-[Woven Geo Bags][44] provide additional filtration properties for sediment control and erosion
protection.

**Geo Grid**: [Geo Grid][45] are used to reinforce soil in roadways, embankments, and slopes,
offering a reliable solution for soil stability.

**Geo Cell**: [Geo Cell][46] is a three-dimensional structure used for stabilizing soil and
preventing erosion, particularly in areas that are prone to instability or waterlogging.

**Gabion**: [Gabion][47] are mesh containers filled with stone or rock, used for stabilization and
erosion control in water bodies and slopes.

**Geo Membrane**: [GEO Membrane][48] is a waterproofing membrane used in applications such as
landfills, ponds, and construction sites to prevent seepage and ensure environmental safety.

**Why Choose Us as Your Geo Fabric Manufacturer?**

When choosing a Geo Textile Manufacturer in Vadodara, there are many factors to consider. Here’s why
we stand out:

**Experience and Expertise**

With years of experience in the industry, we have the technical knowledge and skills to produce
high-quality geotextiles. As a Geotextile Fabric Manufacturer, we understand the intricate needs of
the civil and environmental sectors.

**Quality Assurance**

Our geotextile fabrics are rigorously tested for durability, strength, and resistance to
environmental conditions. This ensures that every product you receive is of the highest quality.

**Wide Product Range**

We offer a diverse range of geotextile products, each designed for specific applications. Whether
you need erosion control fabrics or soil stabilization textiles, we have the right solution for you.

**Sustainability**

Our products are designed with sustainability in mind, helping you create long-lasting, eco-friendly
infrastructure. As a Geotextile Exporter, we are committed to reducing environmental impact while
offering durable solutions.

**Global Reach**

With a strong global footprint, Hi-Tech Speciality Fabrics is a leading Geo Textile Exporter,
trusted by clients worldwide for superior materials. We deliver geosynthetics for civil engineering
projects across the globe, ensuring timely and reliable delivery.

Whether you are looking for Geo Fabric Manufacturers in Vadodara, Geotextile Manufacturers in

**What Are Geotextiles and Geo Fabrics?**

Geotextiles are permeable fabrics used in geotechnical engineering applications. They play a vital
role in soil stabilization, erosion control, and drainage systems. In simple terms, geo fabrics are
materials that help to separate, filter, reinforce, protect, or drain soil in construction projects.

Geotextile materials are made from synthetic fibers such as polypropylene or polyester, which are
woven or nonwoven to create products with varying degrees of strength and flexibility. These fabrics
help manage the natural environment by preventing soil erosion, improving drainage, and stabilizing
roads, railways, and embankments.

**Types of Geotextile Fabrics We Manufacture**

As a leading Geo Textile Manufacturer in India, we offer an extensive range of geotextile fabrics
tailored for various applications. Here are the main types of geotextile fabrics we manufacture:

**Woven Geo Textiles**: Made from woven synthetic fibers, these geotextiles are primarily used for
soil reinforcement and separation in road construction, embankments, and erosion control.

**Non-Woven Geo Textiles**: These are made from synthetic fibers that are bonded together without
weaving. Non-woven geotextiles are widely used for filtration, drainage, and separation
applications.

**Geo Grids**: These geosynthetics are used for reinforcement, particularly in the construction of
roads, embankments, and slopes.

**Geo Cells**: Cellular structures used for controlling soil erosion and stabilizing the ground.

**Geo Membranes****:** Used for waterproofing applications, geo membranes provide a barrier to
liquid and gases, essential in landfills and ponds.

Each of these products is designed for durability and efficiency, ensuring that they contribute
effectively to the success of your civil engineering projects.

**Applications of Geotextile Products**

Geotextiles are versatile materials used in a variety of civil, environmental, and construction
applications. Below are some of the primary ways our geotextile products are used:

**Erosion Control**: **Geotextile fabrics** help to stabilize the soil, preventing erosion due to
wind or water. They are commonly used for coastal protection, slope stabilization, and riverbank
reinforcement.

**Road Construction**: **Geotextiles** improve the stability and durability of roads, railways, and
highways. Our road construction geotextiles are designed to withstand heavy traffic loads while
maintaining soil integrity.

**Drainage Systems**: **Geotextiles** are widely used for filtering water and preventing clogging in
drainage systems. Filtration geotextile rolls are highly effective in keeping the drainage system
efficient and clog-free.

**Landfill Liner Systems**: Geotextiles are used in landfill operations to separate and filter
leachate, ensuring that hazardous materials are contained.

**Coastal Protection**: Used for creating barriers against coastal erosion, geotextiles protect
beaches and shorelines from the damaging effects of waves and storms.

**Slope Stabilization**: Geotextiles help prevent soil slides and enhance the stability of slopes,
ensuring the safety of infrastructure built on sloped terrains.

**Our Product Range**

As a Geo Textile Company, we provide a broad range of geotextile solutions that cater to various
civil and environmental applications. Here’s an overview of the products we manufacture:

**Geo Tube**: [Geo Tubes][40] have large, tubular structures are often used for dewatering purposes
in civil engineering projects, providing an effective solution for managing water during

**Woven Geo Textile**: [Woven Geotextile][41] is a strong, durable fabric used for soil
reinforcement, road construction, and erosion control. Our woven geotextile supplier network ensures
that you get high-quality, dependable products for your projects.

**Non-Woven Geo Textile**: [Non-Woven Geotextiles][42] are excellent for filtration and drainage
applications, making them ideal for use in construction sites, water management, and drainage
systems.

**Woven Geo Bag**: [Woven Geo Bag][43] are used for controlling sediment, erosion, and water
filtration in hydraulic and environmental projects, providing easy handling and excellent
durability.

**Non-Woven Geo Bags**: Similar to woven bags but made with nonwoven geotextile materials,
Non-[Woven Geo Bags][44] provide additional filtration properties for sediment control and erosion
protection.

**Geo Grid**: [Geo Grid][45] are used to reinforce soil in roadways, embankments, and slopes,
offering a reliable solution for soil stability.

**Geo Cell**: [Geo Cell][46] is a three-dimensional structure used for stabilizing soil and
preventing erosion, particularly in areas that are prone to instability or waterlogging.

**Gabion**: [Gabion][47] are mesh containers filled with stone or rock, used for stabilization and
erosion control in water bodies and slopes.

**Geo Membrane**: [GEO Membrane][48] is a waterproofing membrane used in applications such as
landfills, ponds, and construction sites to prevent seepage and ensure environmental safety.

## Validated Durability in High-Stress Applications

Our double-layer woven geotextiles formwork have been successfully implemented in over 5,000
projects nationwide, protecting critical infrastructure and natural environments. Here’s how our
solutions perform in applications:

Our specialized geotextile mattresses provided durable channel lining for one of China’s largest
irrigation systems, preventing water loss and channel erosion while reducing maintenance
requirements.

### [Wuliangsuhai Lake Eco-Reservoir Project][23]

Our environmentally compatible geotextile solutions supported the creation of a sustainable
water-fertilizer ecological system, balancing infrastructure protection with environmental
preservation.

### [Xijiang River Treatment Project, Guangdong][24]

Large-scale implementation of our reinforced geotextile mattress systems stabilized critical
riverbanks, preventing erosion and protecting adjacent infrastructure from flood damage.

###### Flood Control

### [Ordos Hangjin Banner Flood Prevention Project][25]

Strategic application of our high-performance geotextile mattresses provided comprehensive flood
control and embankment protection, safeguarding communities and agricultural land.

###### Water Conservation

### [Urad Rear Banner Reservoir Project][26]

Our premium geotextile mattress technology created a reliable protective barrier for this
large-scale reservoir, preventing seepage losses and ensuring long-term structural integrity while
maintaining water quality for sustainable resource management.

###### Agricultural Infrastructure

### [Panjin High-Standard Farmland Channel Project, Liaoning][27]

Our specialized irrigation channel protection system dramatically improved water delivery efficiency
for this high-value agricultural zone, reducing maintenance costs by 70% and extending
infrastructure lifespan beyond traditional solutions.

Every day you delay addressing erosion and stability issues costs your project money. Our
engineering team is ready to help you identify the right solution for your specific requirements.

## Frequently Asked Questions

1. What certifications do your geosynthetic products have?

*Our products comply with ISO 9001, CE, and GRI-GM13 standards, with additional certifications
available upon request (e.g., ASTM, EN standards for specific markets).*

2. Can you customize geotextiles/geomembranes for my project requirements?

*Yes, we specialize in OEM solutions including custom widths, thicknesses, UV resistance levels, and
tensile strength adjustments to meet engineering specifications.*

3. What's the typical lead time for international orders?

*Standard products ship within 15-20 days after payment confirmation. Rush orders (7-10 days)
available with expedited production fees (varies by quantity).*

4. How do you ensure quality control during production?

*We implement 3-stage QC: raw material inspection (SGS tested), in-process monitoring, and final
pre-shipment testing with third-party verification reports provided.*

5. Do you offer technical support for installation and design?

*Our engineering team provides free basic technical consultation, including CAD drawings and soil
interaction analysis recommendations for complex projects.*

## Frequently Asked Questions

1. What certifications do your geosynthetic products have?

*Our products comply with ISO 9001, CE, and GRI-GM13 standards, with additional certifications
available upon request (e.g., ASTM, EN standards for specific markets).*

2. Can you customize geotextiles/geomembranes for my project requirements?

*Yes, we specialize in OEM solutions including custom widths, thicknesses, UV resistance levels, and
tensile strength adjustments to meet engineering specifications.*

3. What's the typical lead time for international orders?

*Standard products ship within 15-20 days after payment confirmation. Rush orders (7-10 days)
available with expedited production fees (varies by quantity).*

4. How do you ensure quality control during production?

*We implement 3-stage QC: raw material inspection (SGS tested), in-process monitoring, and final
pre-shipment testing with third-party verification reports provided.*

5. Do you offer technical support for installation and design?

*Our engineering team provides free basic technical consultation, including CAD drawings and soil
interaction analysis recommendations for complex projects.*

### [factory icon]

### Self-Owned Factory

Our self-owned factory ensures top-notch quality control, seamless production, and custom solutions
for fleece fabrics. With advanced machinery and skilled artisans, we deliver unparalleled innovation
and excellence.

### [research-and-development]

On-Site Development
 
Every aspect of our fabric development process is continually assessed to meet the unique needs of
our customers. We manage the entire cycle, from R&D to production, all on-site.
 

### [collaboration]

### In-person Collaboration

Perfecting every detail is our business. Our textile specialists collaborate closely with customers
to ensure that ideas and concepts are fully communicated. This crucial step enhances design
precision and speeds up delivery.

### [24-hours service]

### Quick Response

Hanyo's 24/7/365 rapid response team quickly identifies, analyzes, and meets your fabric needs
anytime, anywhere. Enjoy fast turnaround times and top-quality customization. Trust Hanyo for
reliable textile solutions.
About Us

## Hanyo Textile

Changzhou Hanyou Textile Technology Base is the global destination of choice for fabric enthusiasts,
designers and industry professionals seeking first-class textile solutions. Our dyeing and finishing
processor can produce up to 10,000 tonnes per year, and we mainly do processing and production of
any fabrics related to polyester, [**minky plush fabric**][52], [**faux fur**][53], [**sherpa
fleece**][54], [**polar fleece**][55], [**coral fleece**][56],[** ****flannel fleece**,][57][ **glow
in dark fleece**][58], non-woven fabrics, etc. With more than two decades of rich manufacturing
experience in Super Soft, we have become a trusted brand in the international market of fabrics. Our
mission is simple: to provide a wide range of high quality fabrics, while providing excellent
customer service and promoting creative innovation.

Choose Hanyo Textile for a seasoned design team, professional factory, and flexible **ODM & OEM**
services. We offer innovative designs, high-quality production, and eco-friendly materials. Look
forward to working with you! [][60]

## The Sea Will Turn Into The Land

Cost-effective and environmentally sustainable marine reclamation solutions

## Solutions

For 30 years, we have helped engineers, contractors and owners successfully deliver projects,
whether by reducing construction costs, ensuring safety and speed, reducing carbon emissions and
promoting sustainable development. Our proven success allows customers to build with confidence.
[HOKBG Geotextile Tubes Used for Island Cofferdam Construction]

### Island Cofferdam Expansion

HOKBG Geotextile Tube Cofferdams provide an efficient solution for island resort and hotel
construction. Filled with local sand, they create stable cofferdams for beach nourishment,
foundation works, and coastal construction while reducing wave impact, protecting the environment,
and accelerating project completion.

[Learn More][36]
[HOKBG geotextile tubes used for beach creation at an island hotel.]

### Creation of an Artificial Beach for the Island Hotel

HOKBG Geotextile Tubes provide an efficient solution for artificial beach construction. Filled with
local sand, they create stable foundations that retain beach fill, accelerate construction, and
deliver durable, cost-effective solutions for beach development projects.

[Learn More][37]
[HOKBG anti-fouling curtains prevent the spread of seaweed.]

### Prevention of seaweed proliferation

HOKBG Floating Silt Curtains provide an effective solution for floating seaweed containment. They
help confine drifting seaweed within designated areas, making collection and removal more efficient
while reducing the environmental and operational impact of seaweed outbreaks.

[Learn More][38]
[HOKBG Geotextile Tubes for Land Reclamation]

### Port construction-Land reclamation

In land reclamation projects, geotextile tubes are applied for sludge dewatering and building stable
embankments; silt curtains effectively control sediment dispersion and water pollution during
construction; geotextiles provide reinforcement and stability in foundation treatment. Together,
these solutions enhance construction efficiency, protect the marine environment, and ensure
long-term safety and sustainability of reclamation projects.

[Learn More][39]
[HOKBG Geotextile Tubes for Shoreline Protection]

### Coastal Protection, Restoration And Other

Geotextile tubes play a vital role in coastal protection and restoration. When installed along the
shoreline, they effectively resist wave impact, reduce erosion, and encourage beach recovery and
sediment accumulation. Their flexible structure integrates well with the natural environment,
stabilizing the coastline while enhancing ecological conditions. As an eco-friendly and efficient
solution, geotextile tubes provide reliable support for sustainable coastal defense and ecological
restoration.

[Learn More][40]
[HOKBG Geotextile Tubes for Subsea Cable and Pipeline Protection]

### Submarine cables and pipelines-Protection Plan

Geotextile tubes are widely applied in submarine cable and pipeline projects for stabilization and
protection. Positioned over or alongside the structures, they provide effective ballast to prevent
displacement or exposure caused by currents, waves, or external forces. They also reduce the risks
of scouring and suspension, extending the service life of cables and pipelines. With advantages of
easy installation, durability, and environmental compatibility, geotextile tubes offer a reliable
solution for subsea transmission

[HOKBG Geotextile Tubes for Subsea Cable and Pipeline Protection]

### Submarine cables and pipelines-Protection Plan

Geotextile tubes are widely applied in submarine cable and pipeline projects for stabilization and
protection. Positioned over or alongside the structures, they provide effective ballast to prevent
displacement or exposure caused by currents, waves, or external forces. They also reduce the risks
of scouring and suspension, extending the service life of cables and pipelines. With advantages of
easy installation, durability, and environmental compatibility, geotextile tubes offer a reliable
solution for subsea transmission and transport systems.

[Learn More][41]
[HOKBG Geotextiles for Soft Soil Foundation Treatment]

### Filling soft soil foundation treatment

Geotextiles play a crucial role in the treatment of soft foundations created by hydraulic fill.
Placed between the fill material and the weak subsoil, they effectively separate soil layers,
prevent mixing, and provide excellent drainage and filtration to accelerate consolidation. With high
tensile strength and durability, geotextiles significantly improve bearing capacity and stability,
minimizing settlement and failure risks. This ensures a reliable foundation for subsequent port
development, land reclamation, and infrastructure projects.

[Learn More][42]
[Use of HOKBG silt curtains for environmental protection at Jingujiang]

### Dredging and Channel Maintenance

In dredging and channel maintenance projects, geotextile tubes are used to contain and dewater
dredged sediments, forming stable structures that reduce disposal issues and enable resource reuse.
Silt curtains, on the other hand, control sediment dispersion during construction, protecting
surrounding waters and minimizing ecological impacts. Working together, they enhance construction
efficiency while ensuring environmental protection and long-term channel stability, providing
reliable support for sustainable waterway infrastructure.

[Learn More][43]
[HOKBG Silt Curtains for Mangrove Protection]

### Mangrove protection

In mangrove protection and restoration, geotextile tubes can be used to build protective embankments
that resist tidal and wave erosion, creating a stable environment for mangrove growth. Silt curtains
effectively prevent sediment and pollutant dispersion during construction or maintenance, minimizing
disturbance to the ecosystem. Together, they enhance shoreline stability and create favorable
conditions for mangrove recovery, supporting the long-term sustainability of coastal ecosystems

[Learn More][44]
[HOKBG Silt Curtains for Coral Reef Protection]

### Coral reef protection

In coral reef protection projects, silt curtains effectively block sediments and pollutants
generated during construction or dredging, preventing their spread to coral habitats and reducing
turbidity and sedimentation damage. By maintaining clearer water conditions, silt curtains support
coral photosynthesis and ecosystem recovery. They also minimize the impact of human activities on
the marine environment, providing vital protection for the long-term health and sustainability of
coral reefs.

[Learn More][45]
[HOKBG Silt Curtains for Marine Aquaculture Protection]

### Marine aquaculture protection

In marine aquaculture protection, silt curtains effectively isolate sediments, pollutants, and
floating debris from entering farming waters, ensuring clean and stable water quality. They also
reduce the impact of construction or vessel activities on aquaculture areas, lowering risks of
disease and contamination. By maintaining favorable ecological conditions, silt curtains enhance
both the yield and quality of aquaculture, providing reliable support for sustainable fishery
development.

[Learn More][46]

For 30 years, we have helped engineers, contractors and owners successfully deliver projects,
