### Island Cofferdam Expansion

HOKBG Geotextile Tube Cofferdams provide an efficient solution for island resort and hotel
construction. Filled with local sand, they create stable cofferdams for beach nourishment,
foundation works, and coastal construction while reducing wave impact, protecting the environment,
and accelerating project completion.

[Learn More][36]
[HOKBG geotextile tubes used for beach creation at an island hotel.]

### Creation of an Artificial Beach for the Island Hotel

HOKBG Geotextile Tubes provide an efficient solution for artificial beach construction. Filled with
local sand, they create stable foundations that retain beach fill, accelerate construction, and
deliver durable, cost-effective solutions for beach development projects.

[Learn More][37]
[HOKBG anti-fouling curtains prevent the spread of seaweed.]

### Prevention of seaweed proliferation

HOKBG Floating Silt Curtains provide an effective solution for floating seaweed containment. They
help confine drifting seaweed within designated areas, making collection and removal more efficient
while reducing the environmental and operational impact of seaweed outbreaks.

[Learn More][38]
[HOKBG Geotextile Tubes for Land Reclamation]

### Port construction-Land reclamation

In land reclamation projects, geotextile tubes are applied for sludge dewatering and building stable
embankments; silt curtains effectively control sediment dispersion and water pollution during
construction; geotextiles provide reinforcement and stability in foundation treatment. Together,
these solutions enhance construction efficiency, protect the marine environment, and ensure
long-term safety and sustainability of reclamation projects.

[Learn More][39]
[HOKBG Geotextile Tubes for Shoreline Protection]

### Coastal Protection, Restoration And Other

Geotextile tubes play a vital role in coastal protection and restoration. When installed along the
shoreline, they effectively resist wave impact, reduce erosion, and encourage beach recovery and
sediment accumulation. Their flexible structure integrates well with the natural environment,
stabilizing the coastline while enhancing ecological conditions. As an eco-friendly and efficient
solution, geotextile tubes provide reliable support for sustainable coastal defense and ecological
restoration.

[Learn More][40]
[HOKBG Geotextile Tubes for Subsea Cable and Pipeline Protection]

### Submarine cables and pipelines-Protection Plan

Geotextile tubes are widely applied in submarine cable and pipeline projects for stabilization and
protection. Positioned over or alongside the structures, they provide effective ballast to prevent
displacement or exposure caused by currents, waves, or external forces. They also reduce the risks
of scouring and suspension, extending the service life of cables and pipelines. With advantages of
easy installation, durability, and environmental compatibility, geotextile tubes offer a reliable
solution for subsea transmission and transport systems.

[Learn More][41]
[HOKBG Geotextiles for Soft Soil Foundation Treatment]

### Filling soft soil foundation treatment

Geotextiles play a crucial role in the treatment of soft foundations created by hydraulic fill.
Placed between the fill material and the weak subsoil, they effectively separate soil layers,
prevent mixing, and provide excellent drainage and filtration to accelerate consolidation. With high
tensile strength and durability, geotextiles significantly improve bearing capacity and stability,
minimizing settlement and failure risks. This ensures a reliable foundation for subsequent port
development, land reclamation, and infrastructure projects.

[Learn More][42]
[Use of HOKBG silt curtains for environmental protection at Jingujiang]

### Dredging and Channel Maintenance

In dredging and channel maintenance projects, geotextile tubes are used to contain and dewater
dredged sediments, forming stable structures that reduce disposal issues and enable resource reuse.
Silt curtains, on the other hand, control sediment dispersion during construction, protecting
surrounding waters and minimizing ecological impacts. Working together, they enhance construction
efficiency while ensuring environmental protection and long-term channel stability, providing
reliable support for sustainable waterway infrastructure.

[Learn More][43]
[HOKBG Silt Curtains for Mangrove Protection]

### Mangrove protection

In mangrove protection and restoration, geotextile tubes can be used to build protective embankments
that resist tidal and wave erosion, creating a stable environment for mangrove growth. Silt curtains
effectively prevent sediment and pollutant dispersion during construction or maintenance, minimizing
disturbance to the ecosystem. Together, they enhance shoreline stability and create favorable
conditions for mangrove recovery, supporting the long-term sustainability of coastal ecosystems

[Learn More][44]
[HOKBG Silt Curtains for Coral Reef Protection]

### Coral reef protection

In coral reef protection projects, silt curtains effectively block sediments and pollutants
generated during construction or dredging, preventing their spread to coral habitats and reducing
turbidity and sedimentation damage. By maintaining clearer water conditions, silt curtains support
coral photosynthesis and ecosystem recovery. They also minimize the impact of human activities on
the marine environment, providing vital protection for the long-term health and sustainability of
coral reefs.

[Learn More][45]
[HOKBG Silt Curtains for Marine Aquaculture Protection]

### Marine aquaculture protection

In marine aquaculture protection, silt curtains effectively isolate sediments, pollutants, and
floating debris from entering farming waters, ensuring clean and stable water quality. They also
reduce the impact of construction or vessel activities on aquaculture areas, lowering risks of
disease and contamination. By maintaining favorable ecological conditions, silt curtains enhance
both the yield and quality of aquaculture, providing reliable support for sustainable fishery
development.

[Learn More][46]

# Ludlow Jute Manufacturing Company

#### **100** years of excellence in production

Ludlow Jute is proud to be one of India’s premier jute manufacturers and is trusted for its superior
quality jute products. Sprawling along the picturesque banks of the river Hooghly in Chengail, near
Kolkata, the Ludlow campus prides itself on its 1.2 million square feet of jute factory premises,
living, health and education facilities for 1400 families, community spaces and acres for future
expansion. Established in 1921 by the Ludlow Corp. of Ludlow, Massachusetts, United States, Ludlow
Jute Mills andis owned and managed by Kankaria Group, Ludlow Jute has been a trailblazer in the jute
industry for decades. We, at Ludlow Jute, are driven by a strong sense of social and environmental
responsibility.

Show More
[Read More ][130]

## Why Jute

### JUTE, THE GOLDEN FIRE

A natural fiber with a silky lustre and high tensile strength, jute has grown increasingly popular
as the world becomes more environmentally responsible. In addition to its natural, earthy appeal,
jute stands out as an environment-friendly raw material with a multitude of applications. Right from
the first steps of cultivation, jute gives back more than it takes. A hectare of jute consumes 15
tonnes of carbon dioxide and releases 11 tonnes of oxygen in 120 days of growth. Buying jute
wholesale from a low-cost manufacturer like Ludlow Jute is an ideal choice for an environmentally,
quality and cost conscious customer .

## Testimonials

# Our Partner in the USA

“We have had quite a longstanding relationship with Ludlow Jute & Specialities Limited, and the fine
employees we have known over the years. We have worked together to bring Ludlow products to North
America in the erosion control and landscaping industry.

Trust has been built over the years, and we are happy to represent Ludlow in North America. There
were times where we shared bank accounts, so great is our trust in each other. Our working
friendship has lasted generations gone by, and aims to continue onward and upward. We appreciate
each and every member of your staff, as well as the Kanoria family. It is an honor to work
together.”

[+Read More][154] Our partner in the United States of America

# Our Buyer from Finland

”We’ve been Ludlow Jute’s clients for many years. I love how many different products they have in
their selection: it’s so much easier to get all necessary bags and other textile products from one
place. They are good quality and come in endless color and size options.

Their customer service is especially top-notch! We really appreciate the personal correspondence and
we’ve been so lucky and had the same contact person for all this time we’ve been their clients.”

[+Read More][155] Our buyer from Finland

# Our Buyer from Algeria

“For several years, our company has had the pleasure of doing business with Ludlow Jute for the
purchase of yarn, cloth, and bags. The exceptional quality of Ludlow Jute's products and their
impeccable customer service have been key factors that have strengthened our partnership. We are
highly satisfied with the consistent quality Ludlow Jute provides and the reliability of their
deliveries. It is a pleasure to recommend Ludlow Jute for its professionalism and commitment to
excellence.”


[+Read More][156] Our buyer from Algeria

# Our Buyer from the Netherlands

“We are appreciating the kind collaboration with Ludlow we encounter since many years in regards to
the production of jute bags and jute cloth which is well organised and quality is according to the
agreements. Wish to cooperate in near future together as pleasantly”

### Ludlow ICARE Pilot Project

In association with the National Jute Board, the Ludlow ICARE Project focuses on improving the lives
of jute farmers by providing them with technology and educational resources that help them increase
their yield. In the pilot phase, we have adopted the Chapra village in West Bengal where we interact
with as many as 270 farmers. The improvements in cultivation and yield are ultimately for the
dissemination to all jute farmers. We estimate that there are 2 million people in the region whose
livelihoods depend on jute farming.

[View More ][164]

### Ludlow Healthcare

We are committed to improving access to healthcare for the community in Chengail and adjoining
areas. Under the Ludlow Healthcare programme, we cover medical expenses for families with an income
of less than Rs. 300,000per annum. We conduct free health camps for the community and people of
economically weaker sections of society, and focus on pulmonary, renal, cardiovascular diseases as
well as conditions such as thalassemia and hemophilia.

[View More ][165]

### Ludlow Scholarship

We believe that education is the foundation for a better India. Since 2016, Ludlow has been
providing financial support and career guidance to deserving students from economically weaker
backgrounds. This full scholarship covers tuition fees, hostel fees, examination fees, books, as
well as a stipend. Students are also given career guidance and exposure to industry professionals.

# Ludlow Jute Manufacturing Company

#### **100** years of excellence in production

Ludlow Jute is proud to be one of India’s premier jute manufacturers and is trusted for its superior
quality jute products. Sprawling along the picturesque banks of the river Hooghly in Chengail, near
Kolkata, the Ludlow campus prides itself on its 1.2 million square feet of jute factory premises,
living, health and education facilities for 1400 families, community spaces and acres for future
expansion. Established in 1921 by the Ludlow Corp. of Ludlow, Massachusetts, United States, Ludlow
Jute Mills andis owned and managed by Kankaria Group, Ludlow Jute has been a trailblazer in the jute
industry for decades. We, at Ludlow Jute, are driven by a strong sense of social and environmental
responsibility.

Show More
[Read More ][130]

## Why Jute

### JUTE, THE GOLDEN FIRE

A natural fiber with a silky lustre and high tensile strength, jute has grown increasingly popular
as the world becomes more environmentally responsible. In addition to its natural, earthy appeal,
jute stands out as an environment-friendly raw material with a multitude of applications. Right from
the first steps of cultivation, jute gives back more than it takes. A hectare of jute consumes 15
tonnes of carbon dioxide and releases 11 tonnes of oxygen in 120 days of growth. Buying jute
wholesale from a low-cost manufacturer like Ludlow Jute is an ideal choice for an environmentally,
quality and cost conscious customer .

## Testimonials

# Our Partner in the USA

“We have had quite a longstanding relationship with Ludlow Jute & Specialities Limited, and the fine
employees we have known over the years. We have worked together to bring Ludlow products to North
America in the erosion control and landscaping industry.

Trust has been built over the years, and we are happy to represent Ludlow in North America. There
were times where we shared bank accounts, so great is our trust in each other. Our working
friendship has lasted generations gone by, and aims to continue onward and upward. We appreciate
each and every member of your staff, as well as the Kanoria family. It is an honor to work
together.”

[+Read More][154] Our partner in the United States of America

# Our Buyer from Finland

”We’ve been Ludlow Jute’s clients for many years. I love how many different products they have in
their selection: it’s so much easier to get all necessary bags and other textile products from one
place. They are good quality and come in endless color and size options.

Their customer service is especially top-notch! We really appreciate the personal correspondence and
we’ve been so lucky and had the same contact person for all this time we’ve been their clients.”

[+Read More][155] Our buyer from Finland

# Our Buyer from Algeria

“For several years, our company has had the pleasure of doing business with Ludlow Jute for the
purchase of yarn, cloth, and bags. The exceptional quality of Ludlow Jute's products and their
impeccable customer service have been key factors that have strengthened our partnership. We are
highly satisfied with the consistent quality Ludlow Jute provides and the reliability of their
deliveries. It is a pleasure to recommend Ludlow Jute for its professionalism and commitment to
excellence.”

### Ludlow ICARE Pilot Project

In association with the National Jute Board, the Ludlow ICARE Project focuses on improving the lives
of jute farmers by providing them with technology and educational resources that help them increase
their yield. In the pilot phase, we have adopted the Chapra village in West Bengal where we interact
with as many as 270 farmers. The improvements in cultivation and yield are ultimately for the
dissemination to all jute farmers. We estimate that there are 2 million people in the region whose
livelihoods depend on jute farming.

[View More ][164]

### Ludlow Healthcare

We are committed to improving access to healthcare for the community in Chengail and adjoining
areas. Under the Ludlow Healthcare programme, we cover medical expenses for families with an income
of less than Rs. 300,000per annum. We conduct free health camps for the community and people of
economically weaker sections of society, and focus on pulmonary, renal, cardiovascular diseases as
well as conditions such as thalassemia and hemophilia.

[View More ][165]

providing financial support and career guidance to deserving students from economically weaker
backgrounds. This full scholarship covers tuition fees, hostel fees, examination fees, books, as

which has wide usage in civil, mechanical and environmental engineering applications today. The
founders of Manas have been involved in key infrastructure and construction activities since 1996.

At Manas, we adopt sophisticated technologies and processes to manufacture superior quality
Non-Woven Geo Textile & PVC Geo Membrane, suitable for a wide range of applications.

[Read More][16]
WHAT WE DOApplications of Our Geotextiles
[non woven geo textiles application in road constructions]

### Road Construction

India boasts of having World’s second largest network of roads with 5,603,293 Kilometers long road
network (as per 2017 data). Manas Geo Textile is widely used for Reinforcement, Filtration and
Separation of soil layers, important for the road and highway projects.

[non woven geo textiles application in Ports]

### Ports

Indian ports handled 1.135 Million Tons of Traffic in 2017-2018. Indian ports are rapidly growing &
Non-Woven Geo Textiles supplied by Manas are widely used for Soil Stabilisation to support heavy
axle loads.

[non woven geo textiles application in tunnel construstion]

### Tunnels

Non-Woven Geo Textile & Geo Membranes supplied by Manas are used in Tunnel Lining & Provide
Excellent Drainage of Water into the side ditches.

[non woven geo textiles application in Railways]

### Railways

Geo Textiles along with Geo Grid are widely used under Railway Tracks to provide Stabilization &
Reinforcement.

[non woven geo textiles application in landfiles and canal]

### LandFill & Canal

Non-Woven Geo Textiles are used along with Geo Membranes for Landfill & Canal Lining for Drainage of
Water.

[non woven geo textiles application in waterproofing]

### Waterproofing

Non-Woven Geo Textiles are used in all Major Waterproofing Projects to increase the durability of
Waterproofing Coating.

[non woven geo textiles application in RE wall]

### RE Wall

Non-Woven Geo Textiles / Geo Composites are used in RE wall as a Drainage / Filter Media.

Promoters

#### Mr. Dinesh Kanodia

Mr. Dinesh Kanodia is the Founder & Chairman of Manas Geo Tech Pvt. Ltd. He has been a pioneer and
veteran in the infrastructural sector for over 40 years. As the Chairman, he defines the company
vision and strategy and his team delivers success with their unmatched hard work, innovation and
inventiveness to set a new benchmark in the construction industry.

#### Mr. Kartik Kanodia

Mr. Kartik Kanodia is the Director of Sales and Operations at Manas Geo Tech Pvt. Ltd. He builds
innovative strategies and solutions to successfully meet the company’s vision. He meets clients,
governmental bodies, suppliers, buyers and other involved parties ensuring a proper implementation
of projects, compliance with governmental regulation and delivery in quality products and solutions.

### Strengthening Infrastructure

Manas Geo Tech India Pvt. Ltd. is a leading and socially responsible manufacturer of Geo-Synthetics,
which has wide usage in civil, mechanical and environmental engineering applications today. The
founders of Manas have been involved in key infrastructure and construction activities since 1996.

# DISTRIBUTOR GEOTEXTILE WOVEN & NON WOVEN

Selamat Datang di website **CV. MEGA ABADI PERKASA**. Kami merupakan perusahaan distributor
geotextile, non woven dan produk woven yang berdiri sejak tahun 2002. Produk kami antara lain non
woven, non woven geotextile, woven geotextile, felt, felt wool, geobag, velvet laken, laken,
drainage cell, non woven geobag dan non woven felt.

Kami berlokasi di Jakarta Barat. Temukan berbagai produk terbaik kami dengan kualitas dan harga jual
termurah yang bisa Anda dapatkan.

[Know More][19]

## GEOTEXTILE WOVEN

**[Woven Geotextile Hitam][20]**

**[Geotextile Woven][21]**

**[Geotextile Pelapis Tanah][22]**

### Apa Itu Geotextile Woven?

Woven Geotextile adalah suatu bahan sintetis polypropylene untuk memisahkan, menyaring, memperkuat,
melindungi apabila dipergunakan didalam tanah. Geotextile memisahkan tanah mendasari permukaan.
Biasanya di aplikasi di tanah gembur yang berawa atau berair . Salah satu jenis Geotextile adalah
Geotextile woven yang merupakan lembaran tekstil yang dibuat dengan cara menganyam dua set atau
lebih elemen, seperti benang, fiber, pita, atau filamen dari polypropelene yang di rajut dimana
elemen ini saling bertautan dengan bahan dasar pembuatannya dari Polypropilene (PP). Geotekstil
tenun umumnya tipis dan memiliki kekuatan tarik tinggi (bujur lebih besar dari garis lintang) baik
secara vertikal maupun horizontal, serta memiliki stabilitas yang baik.

### Jenis-jenis Geotextile Woven

**Polypropylene Fiber Geotextile Woven**

Polypropylene Geotextile Woven adalah kombinasi kekuatan dan integritas dua set benang yang dijalin
bersama. Bahan dasar Polypropylene memenuhi kebutuhan spesifikasi proyek sesuai ASTM, yang meliputi
kekuatan tarik, kekuatan ambil, ketahanan tusukan, elongasi, stabilisasi termal dan ketahanan sinar
Ultraviolet.

Polypropylene Geotextile Woven adalah solusi hemat biaya untuk pemisah tanah, stabilisasi, filtrasi,
pengendalian erosi dan perlindungan laut. Ini juga tahan terhadap jamur, jamur, dan bahan kimia yang
biasanya ditemukan di tanah. Fungsi perlindungannya tidak terpengaruh oleh sinar ultraviolet dan
faktor lingkungan lainnya, dan sebagai perlindungan, bahan ini tidak perlu dikubur dengan tanah.

**Kelebihan:
**Kuat dan Tahan Lama
Performa Stabil
Tahan terhadap Zat Kimia
Tahan terhadap Panas
Tahan terhadap Sinar Ultraviolet
Tahan terhadap Mikro Organisme dan Serangga

**Kegunaan:
**Konstruksi Jalan Beraspal dan Tidak Beraspal
Tembok Penahan dan Tanggul
Landasan Pacu Bandara
Penguatan lereng
Penanggulangan Longsor
Reklamasi Pantai
Konstruksi Kelautan


**PET Filamen Geotextile Woven**

woven polyester geotextile adalah geotextile woven dengan pola uniaxial dan biaksial yang digunakan
khusus untuk perkuatan yang lebih besar, terutama jika akan menggunakan material yang membutuhkan
kekuatan tinggi dan memiliki daya serap air yang cukup tinggi.

Keuntungan menggunakan tipe ini adalah kekuatan yang sangat tinggi, maksimal bisa mencapai 200 kN/m.
Ketahanan korosi. Permeabilitas air. Mudah disimpan dan diangkut. Ada 2 jenis benang geotekstil
multifilamen, yang dibedakan dengan rajutan biaksial dan uniaksial.

Geotekstil jenis ini biasa digunakan pada proyek stabilisasi jalan dan tanah, yang sangat efektif
dan efisien. Geotekstil jenis ini diproduksi dalam beberapa jenis tergantung berat/gramnya per m2.
Artinya semakin tinggi berat/gram per m2 maka semakin tinggi kuat tariknya. Pemilihan tipe atau tipe
tergantung pada kondisi tanah dasar, penggunaan, serta beban yang direncanakan.

### Fungsi Geotextile Woven

**Fungsi Geotextile Woven
**Geotextile Woven berfungsi sebagai bahan stabilisasi tanah dasar yang biasanya diaplikasikan
sebagai Konstruksi Jalan, Perkuatan Dasar Timbunan, Perkuatan Lereng dan DInding Penahan, Reklamasi
& Pemecah Gelombang, Infrastruktur Bendungan & Irigasi, Konstruksi Jalan Rel & Bandara, Lahan Kerja
Konstruksi, dan lain sebagainya.

Selain itu ada enam tugas pokok dari geotextile woven yang diantaranya:

**Perlindungan
**Mencegah erosi tanggul oleh angin, gelombang, pasang surut dan hujan dan digunakan untuk
melindungi tepian, melindungi lereng, melindungi fondasi dan mencegah erosi tanah.

**Penguatan**
Digunakan dalam proyek geosintetik seperti jalan raya, rel kereta api, bandara, bendungan batu,
pemecah gelombang, dinding penahan tanah, timbunan, penghalang, dll. Untuk mengurangi tekanan tanah,
meningkatkan modulus elastisitas, membatasi slip dan meningkatkan stabilitas.

**Penyaringan**
Ini digunakan untuk menyaring lapisan bendungan, bendungan, sungai dan batuan pan

polyprophylene (PP) yang tidak teranyam, berbentuk seperti karpet kain, dan umumnya berwarna putih.

konstruksi modern dalam berbagai aplikasi teknik sipil..

Non Woven Geotextile terbuat dari serat stapel Polyester atau Polypropylene dengan sifat hidrolik
dan pemisahan yang sangat baik.

Ekonomis

## NON WOVEN FELT

**[Kain Felt][29]**

### Apa Itu Non Woven Felt?

Non Woven Felt adalah bahan mirip kain yang terbuat dari serat stapel (pendek) dan serat panjang
(panjang terus menerus), diikat menjadi satu dengan perlakuan kimia, mekanik, panas atau pelarut.
Istilah ini digunakan dalam industri manufaktur tekstil untuk menunjukkan kain, seperti kain kempa,
yang tidak ditenun atau dirajut. Beberapa bahan non-woven tidak memiliki kekuatan yang cukup kecuali
dipadatkan atau diperkuat dengan penyangga. Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, Non Woven telah menjadi
alternatif untuk busa poliuretan.

### Penggunaan Non Woven Felt

Non Woven Felt tidak dibuat dengan menenun atau merajut dan tidak memerlukan pengubahan serat
menjadi benang. Biasanya, persentase tertentu dari kain daur ulang dan bahan berbasis minyak
digunakan dalam Non Woven Felt. Persentase kain daur ulang bervariasi berdasarkan kekuatan bahan
yang dibutuhkan untuk penggunaan tertentu. Selain itu, beberapa Non Woven Felt dapat didaur ulang
setelah digunakan, dengan perawatan dan fasilitas yang tepat. Untuk alasan ini, beberapa orang
menganggap Non Woven sebagai kain yang lebih ekologis untuk aplikasi tertentu, terutama di bidang
dan industri di mana produk sekali pakai atau sekali pakai penting, seperti rumah sakit, sekolah,
panti jompo, dan akomodasi mewah.

### Fungsi Non Woven Felt

Non Woven Felt menyediakan fungsi khusus seperti daya serap, penolakan cairan, ketahanan,
peregangan, kelembutan, kekuatan, penghambatan api, kemampuan dicuci, bantalan, insulasi termal,
insulasi akustik, filtrasi, digunakan sebagai penghalang bakteri dan sterilitas. Properti ini sering
digabungkan untuk membuat kain yang cocok untuk pekerjaan tertentu, sambil mencapai keseimbangan
yang baik antara masa pakai produk dan biaya. Non Woven Felt dapat meniru penampilan, tekstur, dan
kekuatan kain tenun dan dapat menjadi sebesar bantalan yang paling tebal. Dalam kombinasi dengan
bahan lain Non Woven Felt menyediakan spektrum produk dengan sifat yang beragam, dan digunakan
sendiri atau sebagai komponen pakaian, perabot rumah tangga, perawatan kesehatan, teknik, industri
dan barang konsumen.

yang tidak ditenun atau dirajut. Beberapa bahan non-woven tidak memiliki kekuatan yang cukup kecuali
dipadatkan atau diperkuat dengan penyangga. Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, Non Woven telah menjadi
alternatif untuk busa poliuretan.

### Penggunaan Non Woven Felt

Non Woven Felt tidak dibuat dengan menenun atau merajut dan tidak memerlukan pengubahan serat
menjadi benang. Biasanya, persentase tertentu dari kain daur ulang dan bahan berbasis minyak
digunakan dalam Non Woven Felt. Persentase kain daur ulang bervariasi berdasarkan kekuatan bahan
yang dibutuhkan untuk penggunaan tertentu. Selain itu, beberapa Non Woven Felt dapat didaur ulang
setelah digunakan, dengan perawatan dan fasilitas yang tepat. Untuk alasan ini, beberapa orang
menganggap Non Woven sebagai kain yang lebih ekologis untuk aplikasi tertentu, terutama di bidang
dan industri di mana produk sekali pakai atau sekali pakai penting, seperti rumah sakit, sekolah,
panti jompo, dan akomodasi mewah.

### Fungsi Non Woven Felt

Non Woven Felt menyediakan fungsi khusus seperti daya serap, penolakan cairan, ketahanan,
peregangan, kelembutan, kekuatan, penghambatan api, kemampuan dicuci, bantalan, insulasi termal,
insulasi akustik, filtrasi, digunakan sebagai penghalang bakteri dan sterilitas. Properti ini sering
digabungkan untuk membuat kain yang cocok untuk pekerjaan tertentu, sambil mencapai keseimbangan
yang baik antara masa pakai produk dan biaya. Non Woven Felt dapat meniru penampilan, tekstur, dan
kekuatan kain tenun dan dapat menjadi sebesar bantalan yang paling tebal. Dalam kombinasi dengan
bahan lain Non Woven Felt menyediakan spektrum produk dengan sifat yang beragam, dan digunakan
sendiri atau sebagai komponen pakaian, perabot rumah tangga, perawatan kesehatan, teknik, industri
dan barang konsumen.

Kami jual Non Woven Felt Non yang tersedia dalam berbagai macam ukuran, warna, bentuk dan lebar
dengan harga bersaing.

## GEOBAG

**[Geobag Non Woven][31]**

**[Geobag Kain Non Woven Konstruksi][32]**

### Apa Itu Geobag?

Geobag adalah geotekstil yang diisi dengan tanah dan dijahit untuk membentuk bantalan yang digunakan
untuk menggantikan struktur pelindung batu / pantai konvensional. Geobag lebih stabil secara
hidrolik dan geoteknik karena tas lebih berat, lebih lebar dengan rasio tinggi proporsional dan
berfungsi dengan baik karena terbuat dari blok terintegrasi.

### Kelebihan Geobag

Dinding penahan yang efektif
Meredam gelombang laut
Praktis dan mudah dipasang
Bahan dari pasir sekitarnya
Efektif dan efisien

### Kegunaan & Fungsi Geobag

Pengemasan
Perlindungan abrasi pantai
Pemecah gelombang pantai
Tanggul memegang bahan tanggul
Konstruksi lahan basah

## Woven vs. non-woven — which one fits your job?

Geotextile fabric (sometimes called "geotech fabric") stabilizes and improves soil. The two main
families are built differently and shine in different applications — here's the short version.

### Woven Geotextiles

Strength & Separation

Made by weaving polypropylene strips into a strong, plastic-like fabric specified by tensile
strength. It resists deformation under heavy loads, which is why it's the go-to underlayment beneath
roads, driveways, and parking lots. Drainage through the fabric is limited.
* Best for stabilization & reinforcement
* Very high load capacity
* Excellent under gravel, paths & roadbeds
* Lower water flow-through

### Non-Woven Geotextiles

Filtration & Drainage

Made by needle-punching fibers into a felt-like fabric, referred to by weight (oz/yd²). It's
permeable, so water passes through readily — the right choice for separation, filtration, and
drainage, and the standard pick for French drains.
* Best for filtration & drainage
* Lets water pass while holding back soil
* The go-to fabric for French drains
* Easy to cut and conform to a trench

## The six jobs a geotextile does

#### Separation

Keeps dissimilar soils and aggregate from mixing, so the ground stays even and doesn't sink.

#### Stabilization

Locks the base in place and spreads load, letting you build with less aggregate.

#### Reinforcement

Adds tensile strength to the soil system, reducing rutting and helping damaged ground recover.

#### Filtration

Lets water move through while holding soil particles back, so drainage layers don't clog.

#### Drainage

Carries water away from where it pools, protecting structures, beds, and base layers.

#### Weed Control

Blocks sunlight from weed seeds while still letting air, water, and nutrients reach the soil.

Most projects ask a single fabric to do two or three of these at once — the trick is matching the
fabric to the jobs that matter most. Our [Fabric Selector][154] does exactly that, or read [our full
guide to using and installing landscape fabric][155].

Projul increases efficiency from the office to the field. Contractors save an average of 2+ hours

every month.

## Applications of Our Geotextiles

### Roads

Roads connect cities, villages, and people, making travel and trade possible. They play a vital role
in economic growth by enabling transportation of goods and services. Well-maintained roads also
improve safety, accessibility, and daily life for everyone.

### Highways

Highways are wide roads designed for fast and long-distance travel. They connect major cities and
states, supporting trade and tourism. Good highways reduce travel time and boost economic
development.

### Flyovers

Flyovers are elevated roads built to reduce traffic congestion at busy junctions. They allow smooth
movement of vehicles without interruptions from signals. Flyovers save time, fuel, and improve
overall road safety.

### Canal

Canals are man-made waterways used for irrigation, transportation, and water supply. They help
farmers by providing water to fields throughout the year. Canals also support trade and improve
water management.

### Railways

Railways are an important mode of transport for passengers and goods. They connect distant places
efficiently and at a lower cost. Railways support economic growth and reduce traffic on roads.

### Port

Ports are places where ships dock to load and unload goods and passengers. They support
international trade and connect countries through sea routes. Ports play a key role in economic
growth and global commerce.

### Landfill

A landfill is a site where waste is collected and buried safely. It helps manage solid waste and
keeps cities clean. Proper landfills reduce pollution and protect the environment.

## Applications of Our Geotextiles

### Roads

Roads connect cities, villages, and people, making travel and trade possible. They play a vital role
in economic growth by enabling transportation of goods and services. Well-maintained roads also
improve safety, accessibility, and daily life for everyone.

### Highways

Highways are wide roads designed for fast and long-distance travel. They connect major cities and
states, supporting trade and tourism. Good highways reduce travel time and boost economic
development.

### Flyovers

Flyovers are elevated roads built to reduce traffic congestion at busy junctions. They allow smooth
movement of vehicles without interruptions from signals. Flyovers save time, fuel, and improve
overall road safety.

### Canal

Canals are man-made waterways used for irrigation, transportation, and water supply. They help
farmers by providing water to fields throughout the year. Canals also support trade and improve
water management.

### Railways

Railways are an important mode of transport for passengers and goods. They connect distant places
efficiently and at a lower cost. Railways support economic growth and reduce traffic on roads.

### Port

Ports are places where ships dock to load and unload goods and passengers. They support
international trade and connect countries through sea routes. Ports play a key role in economic
growth and global commerce.

### Landfill

A landfill is a site where waste is collected and buried safely. It helps manage solid waste and
keeps cities clean. Proper landfills reduce pollution and protect the environment.

#### Analytics and Modelling

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

organisations make better revenue decisions.

next”.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is geotextile?

Geotextile is a permeable fabric used in civil engineering to separate, filter, reinforce, and
stabilize soil. It is commonly used in road construction, drainage systems, and erosion control to
improve the strength and durability of infrastructure projects.

### What is the difference between woven and non-woven geotextiles?

Woven geotextile is made by interlacing yarns in a grid pattern, giving it high tensile strength and
making it ideal for load-bearing applications. Non-woven geotextile is made by bonding fibers
together, offering better filtration and permeability, and is typically used for drainage and soil
separation projects.

### What is the difference between geotextile and geomembrane?

Geotextile allows water to pass through while retaining soil, and is used for separation,
filtration, and reinforcement. Geomembrane is an impermeable barrier used for containment and
waterproofing, such as in landfills and water reservoirs.

### Can I use woven geotextile fabric for waterproofing?

Geotextile fabric itself is permeable and it allows water to pass through while filtering soil. For
waterproofing applications like containment or lining, geomembrane is used instead, often alongside
geotextile for added protection and separation.

### How much does woven geotextile fabric cost in India?

Woven geotextile price in India varies based on GSM (fabric weight), tensile strength, roll width,
and order quantity. Contact TechTex for a customized quote based on your project specifications.

### What makes Techtex the best geotextile manufacturer in the global market?

TechTex stands out for its 50+ years of manufacturing experience, ISO-certified production
standards, and customized woven geotextile solutions for infrastructure, agriculture, and industrial
projects. The company manufactures in-house in India and supplies to global markets.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is geotextile?

Geotextile is a permeable fabric used in civil engineering to separate, filter, reinforce, and
stabilize soil. It is commonly used in road construction, drainage systems, and erosion control to
improve the strength and durability of infrastructure projects.

### What is the difference between woven and non-woven geotextiles?

Woven geotextile is made by interlacing yarns in a grid pattern, giving it high tensile strength and
making it ideal for load-bearing applications. Non-woven geotextile is made by bonding fibers
together, offering better filtration and permeability, and is typically used for drainage and soil
separation projects.

### What is the difference between geotextile and geomembrane?

Geotextile allows water to pass through while retaining soil, and is used for separation,
filtration, and reinforcement. Geomembrane is an impermeable barrier used for containment and
waterproofing, such as in landfills and water reservoirs.

### Can I use woven geotextile fabric for waterproofing?

Geotextile fabric itself is permeable and it allows water to pass through while filtering soil. For
waterproofing applications like containment or lining, geomembrane is used instead, often alongside
geotextile for added protection and separation.

### How much does woven geotextile fabric cost in India?

Woven geotextile price in India varies based on GSM (fabric weight), tensile strength, roll width,
and order quantity. Contact TechTex for a customized quote based on your project specifications.

### What makes Techtex the best geotextile manufacturer in the global market?

TechTex stands out for its 50+ years of manufacturing experience, ISO-certified production
standards, and customized woven geotextile solutions for infrastructure, agriculture, and industrial
projects. The company manufactures in-house in India and supplies to global markets.

### Geotextile Dewatering, Sludge Capping, Coastal Protection and Civil Engineering Solutions

At Terravua, we provide end-to-end geotextile, dewatering, environmental, coastal protection, and
civil engineering solutions for some of the toughest challenges in water, waste, sludge, tailings,
and infrastructure management.

By combining advanced geotextile technology, local engineering expertise, practical field
experience, and full construction capability, we deliver solutions that are sustainable,
cost-effective, scalable, and designed for real site conditions.


##### Dewatering Solutions

 

Geotextile Tube Dewatering Systems

Terravua supplies and supports geotextile tube dewatering systems for municipal wastewater sludge,
mining tailings, industrial process sludge, dredged material, agricultural waste, and contaminated
sediments. Geotextile tubes provide a proven, low-energy alternative to mechanical dewatering
systems, helping clients reduce sludge volume, recover water, improve waste handling, and lower
disposal costs.

 

Flocculant Dosing and Mixing Systems
Effective sludge dewatering starts with the correct polymer selection, dosing, and mixing. Terravua
provides engineered flocculant dosing systems, polymer preparation units, static mixers, injection
points, and mobile dosing solutions to improve solids capture, increase drainage rates, and maximise
geotextile tube performance.

 

Mobile and On-Site Dewatering Solutions
Our modular and mobile dewatering systems are designed for rapid deployment on municipal, mining,
industrial, agricultural, and construction sites. These systems allow clients to treat sludge and
wastewater where it is generated, reducing transport costs, improving site efficiency, and creating
a more manageable dry solids product.


##### Environmental and Coastal Solutions


Sludge Capping and Containment
Terravua provides sludge capping and containment solutions for mine tailings facilities, wastewater
ponds, industrial lagoons, contaminated sites, and soft sludge deposits. Using high-strength woven
geotextiles and engineered geosynthetic systems, we help stabilise weak ground, contain contaminated
material, and create a safe foundation for closure, rehabilitation, or future land use.

 

Erosion Control and Coastal Protection
Terravua delivers coastal protection and erosion control solutions using geotextile tubes,
geosynthetic containers, scour protection systems, and engineered shoreline structures. These
systems are designed to reduce wave impact, protect vulnerable coastlines, stabilise embankments,
and support long-term environmental resilience while working with natural coastal processes.


Environmental Rehabilitation and Remediation
We support the rehabilitation of damaged land, wetlands, waterways, ponds, and industrial sites
through practical geosynthetic and civil engineering solutions. Our approach focuses on stabilising
affected areas, improving water and waste management, reducing environmental risk, and supporting
sustainable site recovery.


##### Civil and Construction Solutions

 

Turnkey Geotextile Installation
From technical design and product selection to installation, construction, and project execution,
Terravua provides turnkey geotextile installation services with strong quality control and practical
site management. Our solutions are built around performance, durability, and constructability.

 

Geosynthetic Reinforcement and Infrastructure Support
Terravua supplies and installs geosynthetic reinforcement solutions for roads, embankments,
retaining structures, access platforms, bund linings, working platforms, drainage layers, and
erosion protection systems. These products help improve load distribution, increase stability,
reduce settlement, and extend the service life of critical infrastructure.

 

Custom Engineering Solutions
Every site is different. Terravua develops project-specific civil, environmental, and geotextile
solutions based on site conditions, client objectives, operational constraints, and long-term
performance requirements. Our team works with clients, engineers, contractors, and technology
partners to deliver practical solutions that make technical and commercial sense.


##### Why Terravua?

 

Innovation with Purpose
Every Terravua solution is designed to solve a real-world problem. We focus on improving operational
efficiency, reducing environmental impact, lowering waste handling costs, and creating long-term
value for our clients.

 

End-to-End Project Support
Terravua is more than a product supplier. We support projects from concept and design through to
supply, installation, commissioning, and full project execution.

 

Built on Change – Powered by Connection
Our philosophy is built on connecting people, products, processes, and technologies into lasting
engineering solutions. We believe strong partnerships and practical innovation are the foundation of
better water, waste, and infrastructure management.

### Applications for Geotextile Dewatering, Coastal Protection and Civil Engineering

At Terravua, we do not only supply geotextile products — we deliver complete engineered solutions
that improve the way industries manage water, waste, sludge, tailings, erosion, and infrastructure.

Our geotextile, dewatering, coastal protection, environmental, and civil engineering solutions are
used across multiple sectors where performance, durability, cost control, and environmental
responsibility matter.


##### Dewatering and Sludge Management

 

Terravua provides geotextile dewatering tube solutions for a wide range of sludge and wastewater
applications, including:
* Municipal wastewater treatment works
* Mining operations, tailings, slimes dams, coal fines, and process water
* Industrial sludge from pulp and paper, food processing, chemical, and manufacturing facilities
* Agricultural waste, manure sludge, abattoir waste, and organic process waste
* Dredged material, contaminated sediment, and pond clean-out projects
* Emergency response for flooded sites, contaminated ponds, and high-volume sludge events

Using advanced geotextile dewatering tubes, engineered fabrics, and polymer-assisted dewatering
systems, Terravua provides an efficient and cost-effective alternative to mechanical dewatering. Our
systems help reduce sludge volume, recover valuable water, lower transport and disposal costs,
improve site operations, and produce stable solids for reuse, rehabilitation, or responsible
disposal.


##### Coastal and Environmental Protection

 

Terravua delivers coastal protection, erosion control, and environmental rehabilitation solutions
using engineered geotextile systems and durable geosynthetic structures.


Typical applications include:
* Shoreline protection and coastal erosion control
* Dune stabilisation and beach rehabilitation
* Riverbank, canal, and embankment reinforcement
* Breakwaters, groynes, revetments, and scour protection
* Wetland, pond, and waterway rehabilitation
* Protection of sensitive coastal and environmental zones

Our geotextile structures are designed to provide strength, flexibility, and long-term performance
in challenging hydraulic and environmental conditions. These systems help protect coastlines,
waterways, infrastructure, and natural environments while supporting practical and sustainable
rehabilitation.


##### Civil Engineering and Construction

 

Terravua supports civil construction and infrastructure projects with specialist geotextile
installation, geosynthetic reinforcement, and turnkey project execution.


Applications include:
* Site preparation, earthworks, and working platforms
* Road reinforcement and subgrade stabilisation
* Slope stabilisation and erosion control
* Retaining walls, embankments, and reinforced soil structures
* Bund linings, containment areas, and drainage layers
* Custom installation of geotextile and geosynthetic systems

 

As a civil engineering solutions partner, Terravua does not stop at supplying materials. We assist
with technical design, product selection, logistics, installation, construction support, and full
project execution to ensure every solution is practical, buildable, and aligned with project
requirements.


Our goal is simple: to help clients build stronger infrastructure, manage waste more effectively,
protect natural resources, and deliver projects that stand the test of time.

Terravua provides sludge capping and containment solutions for mine tailings facilities, wastewater
ponds, industrial lagoons, contaminated sites, and soft sludge deposits. Using high-strength woven
geotextiles and engineered geosynthetic systems, we help stabilise weak ground, contain contaminated
material, and create a safe foundation for closure, rehabilitation, or future land use.

 

Erosion Control and Coastal Protection
Terravua delivers coastal protection and erosion control solutions using geotextile tubes,
geosynthetic containers, scour protection systems, and engineered shoreline structures. These
systems are designed to reduce wave impact, protect vulnerable coastlines, stabilise embankments,
and support long-term environmental resilience while working with natural coastal processes.


Environmental Rehabilitation and Remediation
We support the rehabilitation of damaged land, wetlands, waterways, ponds, and industrial sites
through practical geosynthetic and civil engineering solutions. Our approach focuses on stabilising
affected areas, improving water and waste management, reducing environmental risk, and supporting
sustainable site recovery.


##### Civil and Construction Solutions

 

Turnkey Geotextile Installation
From technical design and product selection to installation, construction, and project execution,
Terravua provides turnkey geotextile installation services with strong quality control and practical
site management. Our solutions are built around performance, durability, and constructability.

 

Geosynthetic Reinforcement and Infrastructure Support
Terravua supplies and installs geosynthetic reinforcement solutions for roads, embankments,
retaining structures, access platforms, bund linings, working platforms, drainage layers, and
erosion protection systems. These products help improve load distribution, increase stability,
reduce settlement, and extend the service life of critical infrastructure.

 

Custom Engineering Solutions
Every site is different. Terravua develops project-specific civil, environmental, and geotextile
solutions based on site conditions, client objectives, operational constraints, and long-term
performance requirements. Our team works with clients, engineers, contractors, and technology
partners to deliver practical solutions that make technical and commercial sense.


##### Why Terravua?

 

Innovation with Purpose
Every Terravua solution is designed to solve a real-world problem. We focus on improving operational
efficiency, reducing environmental impact, lowering waste handling costs, and creating long-term
value for our clients.

 

End-to-End Project Support
Terravua is more than a product supplier. We support projects from concept and design through to
supply, installation, commissioning, and full project execution.

 

Built on Change – Powered by Connection
Our philosophy is built on connecting people, products, processes, and technologies into lasting
engineering solutions. We believe strong partnerships and practical innovation are the foundation of
better water, waste, and infrastructure management.

### Applications for Geotextile Dewatering, Coastal Protection and Civil Engineering

At Terravua, we do not only supply geotextile products — we deliver complete engineered solutions
that improve the way industries manage water, waste, sludge, tailings, erosion, and infrastructure.

Our geotextile, dewatering, coastal protection, environmental, and civil engineering solutions are
used across multiple sectors where performance, durability, cost control, and environmental
responsibility matter.


##### Dewatering and Sludge Management

 

Terravua provides geotextile dewatering tube solutions for a wide range of sludge and wastewater
applications, including:
* Municipal wastewater treatment works
* Mining operations, tailings, slimes dams, coal fines, and process water
* Industrial sludge from pulp and paper, food processing, chemical, and manufacturing facilities
* Agricultural waste, manure sludge, abattoir waste, and organic process waste
* Dredged material, contaminated sediment, and pond clean-out projects
* Emergency response for flooded sites, contaminated ponds, and high-volume sludge events

Using advanced geotextile dewatering tubes, engineered fabrics, and polymer-assisted dewatering
systems, Terravua provides an efficient and cost-effective alternative to mechanical dewatering. Our
systems help reduce sludge volume, recover valuable water, lower transport and disposal costs,
improve site operations, and produce stable solids for reuse, rehabilitation, or responsible
disposal.


##### Coastal and Environmental Protection

 

Terravua delivers coastal protection, erosion control, and environmental rehabilitation solutions
using engineered geotextile systems and durable geosynthetic structures.


Typical applications include:
* Shoreline protection and coastal erosion control
* Dune stabilisation and beach rehabilitation
* Riverbank, canal, and embankment reinforcement
* Breakwaters, groynes, revetments, and scour protection
* Wetland, pond, and waterway rehabilitation
* Protection of sensitive coastal and environmental zones

Our geotextile structures are designed to provide strength, flexibility, and long-term performance
in challenging hydraulic and environmental conditions. These systems help protect coastlines,
waterways, infrastructure, and natural environments while supporting practical and sustainable
rehabilitation.


##### Civil Engineering and Construction

 

Terravua supports civil construction and infrastructure projects with specialist geotextile
installation, geosynthetic reinforcement, and turnkey project execution.


Applications include:
* Site preparation, earthworks, and working platforms
* Road reinforcement and subgrade stabilisation
* Slope stabilisation and erosion control
* Retaining walls, embankments, and reinforced soil structures
* Bund linings, containment areas, and drainage layers
* Custom installation of geotextile and geosynthetic systems

 

As a civil engineering solutions partner, Terravua does not stop at supplying materials. We assist
with technical design, product selection, logistics, installation, construction support, and full
project execution to ensure every solution is practical, buildable, and aligned with project
requirements.


Our goal is simple: to help clients build stronger infrastructure, manage waste more effectively,
protect natural resources, and deliver projects that stand the test of time.

## [Mohammd (Anik) Yousuf][53]

**Founder, TextileTuts**

As a textile engineer with a bachelor’s degree from Ahsanullah University of Science & Technology,
I’ve always had a deep love for everything related to textiles. After spending three rewarding years
as a Production Engineer at Knit Concern LTD, a leading composite garment factory, I decided to
combine my passion for blogging and textiles to create something truly special.

TextileTuts.com is my brainchild, born out of a desire to share my knowledge and engage with a wider
audience.

With TextileTuts.com, my mission is to empower individuals to explore the fascinating world of
textiles. I want to bridge the gap between technical expertise and creative expression, ensuring
that even the most complex topics are presented in an approachable and engaging manner.

Whether you’re a student, a professional, or simply captivated by the artistry of fabrics, I invite
you to join me on this enlightening journey through the intricate realm of textiles. Together, let’s
unravel the wonders and possibilities that this industry holds.

Textile Engineer
Production Experience
[Anik Yusuf]

## Material Pilihan terbaik untuk Project Anda

#### [Geogrid][19]

Geogrid banyak digunakan pada proyek jalan raya, rel kereta api, dinding penahan tanah, area
reklamasi, hingga tambang terbuka.

#### [Geocell][20]

Geocell dibuat dari bahan polimer berkualitas tinggi seperti HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) yang
kuat, fleksibel, dan tahan terhadap kondisi lingkungan ekstrem.

#### [Kawat Bronjong][21]

Penggunaan kawat bronjong tidak hanya terbatas pada proyek besar seperti jalan raya, jembatan, dan
bendungan, tetapi juga banyak diaplikasikan pada skala lebih kecil seperti taman.

#### [Vertical Garden][22]

Vertical Garden merupakan sistem penanaman tanaman secara vertikal di dinding atau permukaan tegak,
baik di luar maupun di dalam ruangan.

#### [Drainage Tank atau Modular Tank][23]

Drainage Tank terbuat dari material plastik berkekuatan tinggi seperti HDPE (High Density
Polyethylene) yang dirancang dalam bentuk modular berongga.

#### [Geobag][24]

Geobag adalah kantong geotekstil yang diisi dengan material seperti pasir atau tanah, digunakan
sebagai solusi perlindungan tebing sungai, pantai, tanggul, maupun struktur penahan erosi.

Penggunaan kawat bronjong tidak hanya terbatas pada proyek besar seperti jalan raya, jembatan, dan

Vertical Garden merupakan sistem penanaman tanaman secara vertikal di dinding atau permukaan tegak,
baik di luar maupun di dalam ruangan.

Drainage Tank terbuat dari material plastik berkekuatan tinggi seperti HDPE (High Density
Polyethylene) yang dirancang dalam bentuk modular berongga.

Geobag adalah kantong geotekstil yang diisi dengan material seperti pasir atau tanah, digunakan
sebagai solusi perlindungan tebing sungai, pantai, tanggul, maupun struktur penahan erosi.

water, and air, and reduce carbon footprint. Our products are used in civil, environmental, and
geotechnical projects in a variety of sectors, including Civil Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater
Management, Mining, Oil and Gas, Hydroelectric, Agriculture and Sports & Recreation. We pride

products, and value at the forefront of what we do.

geogrid-supported roadway design for engineers, contractors, and project owners. Using
industry-recognized methodologies—including Giroud-Han for unpaved roads and Modified AASHTO 1993
for paved and unpaved applications—the calculator delivers instant design calculations and
reinforcement recommendations based on your project-specific inputs. Generate detailed PDF design
summaries and optimize aggregate thickness with confidence. Whether you’re designing haul roads,
access roads, working platforms, or permanent pavements, the Calculator helps you make faster,
smarter, and more cost-effective design decisions.

[Try the Calculator][55]

protect critical infrastructure, manage water and containment challenges, and stabilize land for

engineered solutions that perform in the field—today and into the future.

## Featured Tool: Titan Road Design Calculator

The Titan Road Design Calculator is a powerful online design tool built to simplify
geogrid-supported roadway design for engineers, contractors, and project owners. Using
industry-recognized methodologies—including Giroud-Han for unpaved roads and Modified AASHTO 1993
for paved and unpaved applications—the calculator delivers instant design calculations and
reinforcement recommendations based on your project-specific inputs. Generate detailed PDF design
summaries and optimize aggregate thickness with confidence. Whether you’re designing haul roads,
access roads, working platforms, or permanent pavements, the Calculator helps you make faster,
smarter, and more cost-effective design decisions.

[Try the Calculator][55]

### Welcome to tynod geosynthetics

Tynod Geosynthetics specialize in providing a complete range of geosynthetic solutions designed to
meet the evolving needs of construction, civil engineering, and environmental protection projects
worldwide. With over 15 years of industry expertise, we have become a trusted one-stop supplier for
customers seeking reliable products, professional service, and technical support.

Our product portfolio includes **geocells, geogrids, geotextiles, geomembranes, geonets, 3D geomats,
drainage boards, coir blankets, grass pavers, cement blankets, and more**. Each product is carefully
manufactured to meet international quality standards and is widely applied in **soil stabilization,
erosion control, road construction, embankment reinforcement, landfill lining, and water management
projects**.

We serve a global network of distributors, construction companies, and end-users across **South
America, the Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, Europe, America, and Australia**. By offering a
wide selection under one roof, Tynod simplifies the procurement process and ensures our clients
benefit from **competitive pricing, fast delivery, and dependable performance**.

Our mission is simple: to deliver **quality, trust, and long-term value** through our geosynthetic
solutions. Whether you are expanding infrastructure, reinforcing terrain, or managing environmental
challenges, Tynod stands as your reliable partner in building sustainable foundations for the
future.

# Welcome to Umasree, Leading FIBC Bags Manufacturer for Global Businesses

Umasree Texplast Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 22000:2018 certified company (Food
Safety Management) and Government of India Recognized Export House. We are leading manufacturers of
a range of FIBC packaging solutions & varied other products including PP Woven Fabrics, PP woven
sacks, FIBC Bags, BOPP Bags, Block Bottom Bags, Bale Wrap Fabrics, Woven GeoTextiles, Woven
GroundCovers & Slit Fence. Our Packaging Solutions are currently used in various industries
including fertilizer, cement, sand, food grains, sugar, cattle feed, fish meal, pulses, spices,
dates, agro products, minerals, resin, polymers, rubber, etc.

#### AT UMASREE, WE ENSURE SAFETY OF YOUR PRODUCT FROM SPILLAGE OR DAMAGE.

##### WE OFFER AN ARRAY OF EFFECTIVE AND SUPERIOR FIBC PACKAGING SOLUTIONS,

##### THUS HOLDING YOUR PRODUCT'S GOODNESS TOGETHER.

Umasree's rich international experience gave rise to a separate Clean Room facility named [**Bulk
Corp International**][58]. It is a BRC, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and OHSAS 18001:2007 certified
company, and is established to specifically manufacture Food Grade FIBC bags.

[**Contact us**][59] to further explore the FIBC products offered by India's premium Bulk Bag
supplier for your business

## A Trend-setting Legacy

A look at our timeline that has been definitive of our present and our future endeavors.

### 1985

Gopalka family, under the visionary foresight of Late Mr. Mahendra Gopalka, emerges as Gujarat's
first PP Industry - A venture that dominated the market for 2 decades.

[1985]

### 2004

Mr. Anup Gopalka, continuing on the legacy, shapes into reality, Umasree Texplast as a premier FIBC
bag manufacturer, nestled in Gujarat's prominent industrial hub

[2004]

### 2008

Production of FIBC bags in full-throttle using highly competitive materials & state-of-the-art
technology. Finest extrusion & weaving equipment assimilated to expand production capacity & product
niche.

[2008]

### 2010

Mr. Punit Gopalka's advent as a visionary leader to make Umasree the absolute leader in packaging
solutions, with focus on FIBC bags.

[2010]

### 2012

Mr. Ankit Fogla directed the company focus towards exports through technology augmentation,
professional client service & facility standardization.

[2012]

### 2016-17

Inception of [Bulk Corp International][60], a BRC certified company focusing primarily on
international Food Grade FIBC bags markets.

[2016]

### 2018

Major expansion projects & technology assimilation plans mobilized with the vision to constantly
stay ahead of the market.

[Timeline 2018]

### 2020-21

Inception of [Solos Polymers][61], actively developing new flexible packaging solutions with
evolving technologies that efficiently addresses customer's dynamic needs.

[Timeline 2021]

### 2022

We are proud to announce the appointment of Mr. Punit Gopalka as the first Indian to hold the chair

[Timeline 2022]

### 2022

Joint Venture between [Packem][63] (Brazil) & Umasree (India) to setup 1st plant in Asia, for
producing 100% sustainable FIBCs from recycled PET (rPET).

leading FIBC Bags manufacturer from India with superior products that meet international standards
and are completely customisable to meet your particular requirements.

Manufactured to the highest food safety standards internationally, our Bulk Bags are among the best
in the industry. Besides, our broad range of premium quality Jumbo Bags and container liners meet
the specific needs of multiple industry sectors worldwide.

With a strong global network, you can rely on us for meeting even the most stringent packaging and
storage demands, while assuring fast international and domestic delivery.

# [Experience, Quality & Safety][23]

We’re fabricators, contractors, and craftsmen, but more importantly, ***we’re problem solvers***. As
a leader in specialty construction Louisiana, we serve a diverse industrial market in plastic pipe,
containment liners, and erosion control systems. Our team operates as a full-service specialty
construction contractor, delivering engineered solutions with precision, safety, and long-term
performance in mind. From complex containment to high-performance piping systems, we bring the
experience of a trusted industrial construction contractor to every project across Louisiana and the
Gulf Coast.

[View Our Services][24]
[us-fusion-employees]

**For quality you can trust and industry expertise at the ready, there’s no better team for the job
than US FUSION.**

[Contact Our Team][25]

## Your Industry Supplier for All Your Specialty Construction Needs

US FUSION has over 35 years of diversified experience in specialty construction Louisiana,
supporting energy, petrochemical, municipal, and manufacturing sectors. As a licensed specialty
construction contractor, our skilled experts have worked across industries to develop reliable,
long-lasting solutions that meet demanding technical standards. Clients choose us not only as a
materials supplier, but as a proven industrial construction contractor capable of delivering
complete supply-and-install solutions throughout Louisiana.
* Energy & Power Plants
* Manufacturing Facilities
* Petrochemical Refineries
* Municipal & Government Projects
  & more

[About US FUSION][26]

## Turnkey Solutions

Our customers look to US FUSION to lead with innovation and deliver smart, turnkey solutions to
complex problems. In the world of specialty construction Louisiana, that means providing a single

# Manufacturing Geotextile Fabrics for Civil Engineering

## Who We Are

Established in 1994, WINFAB specializes in the domestic manufacturing of high-performance geotextile
and industrial fabrics engineered for civil construction and environmental applications. The company
is an American owned and operated organization with two production facilities located in the heart
of Georgia. **We are driven to support the industry by delivering on continual improvement and
innovation of products, superior customer service, and reinforcing America’s investment in our
future, our communities, and our environment.**
REINFORCING SUCCESS
At WINFAB, our diversity in domestic manufacturing enables us to lead the industry in customer
service and on-time deliveries.
* Woven Technologies
* Nonwoven Technologies
  (Expansion Coming Soon!)
* Erosion Control Blankets & Wattles
* Conversion of Rolled Goods
* Printing of Finished Goods
* Production of Wood Accessories
* Silt Fence Assembly
* Custom Fabrication
* Sewing & Converting of Geotextile Tubes & Bags

## Solutions We Provide

**At WINFAB, our priority is to support our distribution partners and their customers.** We are the
leading manufacturer with a complete geosynthetic and erosion control product line offering, and we
enable the sourcing of domestic readily available construction materials such as geotextiles, silt
fence, and erosion control blankets required for all state and federal DOT projects. If you don’t
see what you are looking for below, we invite you to connect with us by clicking [here][23] and a
WINFAB representative will contact you.

* [
  
  #### TECHNICAL SERVICES
  
  ][33]
From the pellet to the pallet, WINFAB employees ensure that the products we manufacture meet or
exceed all industry safety and quality standards, verifying that all of our products are compliant
with AASHTO NTPEP and ASTM requirements. Additionally, our company excels in providing unique
solutions tailored to fit our customers project specific needs maintaining compliance with
engineer’s specification for stabilization, filtration, reinforcement, separation, erosion control
and dewatering requirements.

Our team is comprised of engineers and industry professionals who have decades of manufacturing and
field experience, who actively participate and advise in the development and use of geosynthetics
for sustainable and resilient infrastructure solutions. WINFAB’s research and continued
technological growth earned a legacy of development and innovation, and we continue to create new
and improved products to address design challenges. We commit to product and service quality
unmatched in the industry.

### Made in USA Available

Please contact us to discuss our products that are Made in America to meet the standards for state
departments of transportation (D.O.T.) and federally funded projects. Special certification may be
required depending on the project specifications.
* FEATURED PRODUCT
  **WINFAB Diamondback 4030** is a three dimensional high performance turf reinforcement mat
  (HP-TRM).
  It is manufactured using a special heat stabilization process to drastically increase the
  effectiveness of the pyramidal weave when incorporated in steep slope and vegetated applications
  where high performance is required for soils and root systems.
  
  
  
  [LEARN MORE »][34]
* FEATURED PRODUCT
  **WINFAB 400HTM** is manufactured using high tenacity polypropylene yarns that are woven to form a
  dimensionally stable network, which allows the yarns to maintain their relative position. It
  resists ultraviolet deterioration, rotting, and biological degradation and is inert to commonly
  encountered soil chemicals.
  
  [LEARN MORE »][35]

From the pellet to the pallet, WINFAB employees ensure that the products we manufacture meet or
exceed all industry safety and quality standards, verifying that all of our products are compliant
with AASHTO NTPEP and ASTM requirements. Additionally, our company excels in providing unique
solutions tailored to fit our customers project specific needs maintaining compliance with
engineer’s specification for stabilization, filtration, reinforcement, separation, erosion control
and dewatering requirements.

Our team is comprised of engineers and industry professionals who have decades of manufacturing and
field experience, who actively participate and advise in the development and use of geosynthetics
for sustainable and resilient infrastructure solutions. WINFAB’s research and continued
technological growth earned a legacy of development and innovation, and we continue to create new
and improved products to address design challenges. We commit to product and service quality
unmatched in the industry.

### Made in USA Available

departments of transportation (D.O.T.) and federally funded projects. Special certification may be
required depending on the project specifications.

  **WINFAB Diamondback 4030** is a three dimensional high performance turf reinforcement mat
  (HP-TRM).
  It is manufactured using a special heat stabilization process to drastically increase the
  effectiveness of the pyramidal weave when incorporated in steep slope and vegetated applications
  where high performance is required for soils and root systems.

* FEATURED PRODUCT
  **WINFAB 400HTM** is manufactured using high tenacity polypropylene yarns that are woven to form a
  dimensionally stable network, which allows the yarns to maintain their relative position. It
  resists ultraviolet deterioration, rotting, and biological degradation and is inert to commonly
  encountered soil chemicals.

* FEATURED PRODUCT
  **WINFAB Silt Fence with Wood Stakes** consists of a complete line of Silt Fence filter fabrics
  attached to hardwood stakes. WINFAB can attach any Silt Fence fabric to an appropriate size
  hardwood stake in order to meet the needs of any project.
